l-m-e5-b01-01.title: Ti agbegbe ba kanna, ṣe agbegbe ita naa kanna?
l-m-e5-b01-01.topic: Agbegbe ati agbegbe ita onigun mẹrin
l-m-e5-b01-01.goal: Ṣayẹwo boya ẹtọ pe awọn onigun mẹrin ti agbegbe wọn kanna ni agbegbe ita kanna jẹ otitọ nigbagbogbo; wa ki o ṣalaye ọran ti kii ṣe otitọ.
l-m-e5-b01-01.material: Ẹtọ: Onigun mẹrin meji ti agbegbe wọn kanna ni agbegbe ita kanna. Wa tọkọtaya onigun mẹrin ti o fihan pe ẹtọ ko tọ. (Ẹyọ: cm)
l-m-e5-b01-01.s.s1.r.a: Onigun mẹrin kanna ni ti a yi si ẹgbẹ; nitorina agbegbe ita naa kanna, 22.
l-m-e5-b01-01.s.s1.r.c: Awọn agbegbe wọn yatọ, 20 ati 40; nitorina ko le ṣe idanwo ẹtọ naa.
l-m-e5-b01-01.s.s1.r.d: Apẹrẹ kanna ni, nitorina agbegbe ita naa kanna. Eyi ba ẹtọ mu.
l-m-e5-b01-01.s.s1.explain: Agbegbe mejeeji jẹ 24, ṣugbọn agbegbe ita jẹ 28 ati 20. Paapaa ti agbegbe ba kanna, agbegbe ita le yatọ.
l-m-e5-b01-01.s.s2.model.0: 2×12=24 ati 4×6=24, nitorina agbegbe kanna, ṣugbọn agbegbe ita jẹ 28 ati 20; ẹtọ ko tọ.
l-m-e5-b01-01.s.s2.model.1: Paapaa pẹlu agbegbe kanna, agbegbe ita yipada ti apẹrẹ ba gun-tẹẹrẹ ni ọna oriṣiriṣi; tọkọtaya yii jẹ apẹẹrẹ atako.

l-m-e5-b02-01.goal: Ṣayẹwo boya ẹtọ pe olupin apapọ kere ju ọja awọn nọmba meji jẹ otitọ nigbagbogbo; wa ki o ṣalaye apẹẹrẹ ti kii ṣe otitọ.

l-m-e5-b02-01.s.s1.r.a: 24 kere ju ọja 96 lọ. Eyi ba ẹtọ mu.
l-m-e5-b02-01.s.s1.r.c: 12 kere ju ọja 24 lọ. Eyi ba ẹtọ mu.

l-m-e5-b02-01.s.s1.explain: Olupin apapọ kekere ti 3 ati 5, 15, dọgba pẹlu ọja 3×5=15. Kii kere ju ọja lọ.

l-m-e5-b02-02.title: Ti ipilẹ ba gun ju, ṣe agbegbe onigun mẹta tobi ju?
l-m-e5-b02-02.goal: Ṣayẹwo boya ẹtọ pe onigun mẹta ti ipilẹ rẹ gun ni agbegbe nla ju jẹ otitọ nigbagbogbo; wa ki o ṣalaye apẹẹrẹ ti kii ṣe otitọ.
l-m-e5-b02-02.material: Ẹtọ: Ninu onigun mẹta meji, eyi ti ipilẹ rẹ gun ni agbegbe nla ju. Wa tọkọtaya ti o tako ẹtọ yii. (Ẹyọ: cm)
l-m-e5-b02-02.s.s1.r.a: Awọn agbegbe jẹ 16 ati 10, nitorina eyi ti ipilẹ gun tobi. Eyi ba ẹtọ mu.
l-m-e5-b02-02.s.s1.r.b: Awọn agbegbe jẹ 13.5 ati 6, nitorina eyi ti ipilẹ gun tobi. Eyi ba ẹtọ mu.
l-m-e5-b02-02.s.s1.r.c: Awọn ipilẹ kanna ni, nitorina a ko le ṣe idanwo ẹtọ naa.
l-m-e5-b02-02.s.s1.explain: Ipilẹ 10, giga 2 ni agbegbe 10; ipilẹ 6, giga 5 ni agbegbe 15. Eyi ti ipilẹ kuru ni agbegbe nla.
l-m-e5-b02-02.s.s2.model.0: 10×2÷2=10 ati 6×5÷2=15; eyi ti ipilẹ kuru ni agbegbe nla, nitorina ẹtọ ko tọ.
l-m-e5-b02-02.s.s2.model.1: Agbegbe da lori ipilẹ ati giga papọ; nitorina ti giga ba tobi, agbegbe le tobi paapaa ti ipilẹ ba kuru.

l-m-e5-b02-04.goal: Ṣayẹwo boya ẹtọ nipa irisi eleemewa ida ti ipin rẹ jẹ oni-nọmba kan jẹ otitọ nigbagbogbo; wa ki o ṣalaye apẹẹrẹ ti kii ṣe otitọ.
l-m-e5-b02-04.material: Ẹtọ: Gbogbo ida pẹlu ipin oni-nọmba kan ti o di eleemewa deede ni aaye eleemewa akọkọ nikan. Wa ida ti o tako ẹtọ naa.
l-m-e5-b02-04.s.s1.prompt: Yan ida ti o tako ẹtọ naa (apẹẹrẹ atako).

l-m-e5-b02-04.s.s2.model.1: Pẹlu ipin 4, lilo 100 fun 25/100; nitorina o ni aaye meji gẹgẹ bi 0.25.

l-m-e5-b02-05.title: A na-enwe naanị otu ahịrị akara symmetry mgbe niile?
l-m-e5-b02-05.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta gbasara ọnụ ọgụgụ ahịrị symmetry nke ọdịdị nwere akara symmetry ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ na-emegide ya).
l-m-e5-b02-05.material: Nkwupụta: Ọdịdị nwere akara symmetry na-enwe naanị otu ahịrị symmetry mgbe niile. N'ime mkpụrụedemede sans-serif A, T, H, Y, chọta nke na-egosi na nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.
l-m-e5-b02-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ mkpụrụedemede na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ (ihe atụ na-emegide ya).
l-m-e5-b02-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-adakọ mgbe e tụgharịrị ya n'otu ahịrị kwụ ọtọ naanị. O nwere axis 1.
l-m-e5-b02-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-adakọ mgbe e tụgharịrị ya n'otu ahịrị kwụ ọtọ naanị. O nwere axis 1.
l-m-e5-b02-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-adakọ mgbe e tụgharịrị ya n'otu ahịrị kwụ ọtọ naanị. O nwere axis 1.
l-m-e5-b02-05.s.s1.explain: H na-adakọ mgbe a tụgharịrị ya n'ebe abụọ: ahịrị kwụ ọtọ gafere etiti na ahịrị dị larịị gafere etiti. O nwere ahịrị symmetry 2.
l-m-e5-b02-05.s.s2.model.0: H na-adakọ ma e tụgharịa ya kwụ ọtọ ma ọ bụ n'akụkụ, ya mere o nwere ahịrị symmetry 2, nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-m-e5-b02-05.s.s2.model.1: A, T, na Y nwere axis 1, ma H nwere axis 2, ya mere H bụ ihe atụ na-emegide ya.

l-m-e5-b03-01.title: Ṣe onigun deede ti ẹgbẹ pupọ ni agbegbe ita gigun ju?
l-m-e5-b03-01.goal: Ṣayẹwo boya ẹtọ “onigun deede ti ẹgbẹ rẹ pọ si ni agbegbe ita to gun” jẹ otitọ nigbagbogbo; wa ki o ṣalaye apẹẹrẹ ti kii ṣe otitọ.
l-m-e5-b03-01.material: Ẹtọ: Bi ẹgbẹ onigun deede ba pọ si, agbegbe ita rẹ gun ju. Wa onigun deede meji ti o tako ẹtọ naa. (Ẹyọ: cm)

l-m-e5-b03-02.title: Ṣe nọmba ti o ni nọmba eleemewa diẹ sii maa n tobi?
l-m-e5-b03-02.goal: Ṣayẹwo boya ẹtọ “eleemewa ti o ni nọmba pupọ lẹhin aaye eleemewa tobi” jẹ otitọ nigbagbogbo; wa ki o ṣalaye apẹẹrẹ ti kii ṣe otitọ.
l-m-e5-b03-02.material: Ẹtọ: Bi nọmba eleemewa ba ni nọmba pupọ lẹhin aaye eleemewa, nọmba naa tobi. Wa nọmba meji ti o tako ẹtọ yii.
l-m-e5-b03-02.s.s1.r.a: 0.234 tobi. Eyi ti o ni nọmba diẹ sii tobi, nitorina o ba ẹtọ mu.
l-m-e5-b03-02.s.s1.r.b: 0.61 tobi. Eyi ti o ni nọmba diẹ sii tobi, nitorina o ba ẹtọ mu.
l-m-e5-b03-02.s.s1.r.c: 0.45 tobi. Eyi ti o ni nọmba diẹ sii tobi, nitorina o ba ẹtọ mu.
l-m-e5-b03-02.s.s1.explain: 0.9 jẹ 0.90 o si tobi ju 0.12 lọ. Nọmba ti o ni nọmba diẹ le tun tobi.
l-m-e5-b03-02.s.s2.model.0: 0.9=0.90 tobi ju 0.12 lọ; paapaa pẹlu nọmba diẹ, o le tobi, nitorina ẹtọ ko tọ.
l-m-e5-b03-02.s.s2.model.1: A fi eleemewa we lati ipo ti o ga julọ; 0.9 ni 9 ni ipo tenths, o tobi ju 0.12 ti o ni 1 nibẹ.

l-m-e5-b03-03.title: Ti ipin ba yatọ, ṣe titobi naa yatọ naa?
l-m-e5-b03-03.goal: Ṣayẹwo boya ẹtọ “awọn ida ti ipin wọn yatọ yatọ ni titobi” jẹ otitọ nigbagbogbo; wa ki o ṣalaye apẹẹrẹ ti kii ṣe otitọ.
l-m-e5-b03-03.material: Ẹtọ: Ida meji ti ipin wọn yatọ yatọ ni titobi. Wa ida meji ti o tako ẹtọ yii.
l-m-e5-b03-03.s.s1.prompt: Yan ida meji ti o tako ẹtọ naa (apẹẹrẹ atako).
l-m-e5-b03-03.s.s1.r.a: 1/3 tobi. Titobi yatọ, nitorina o ba ẹtọ mu.
l-m-e5-b03-03.s.s1.r.c: Wọn jẹ 14/35 ati 15/35, nitorina titobi yatọ. Eyi ba ẹtọ mu.
l-m-e5-b03-03.s.s1.r.d: Awọn ipin kanna ni, nitorina wọn ko le ṣe idanwo ẹtọ naa.
l-m-e5-b03-03.s.s1.explain: Yiyọ 3 kuro ninu 3/6 fun 1/2. Paapaa ti ipin ba yatọ, titobi le dọgba.
l-m-e5-b03-03.s.s2.model.0: 3/6=1/2, nitorina titobi dọgba paapaa pẹlu ipin oriṣiriṣi; ẹtọ ko tọ.
l-m-e5-b03-03.s.s2.model.1: Ti o ba sọ nọmba oke ati ipin di pupọ pẹlu nọmba kanna, titobi wa kanna botilẹjẹpe ipin yipada; 1/2 ati 3/6 jẹ apẹẹrẹ atako.

l-m-e5-b03-04.title: Ti ipin ogorun ba ga, ṣe nọmba eniyan naa ga naa?
l-m-e5-b03-04.goal: Ṣayẹwo boya ẹtọ “eyi ti ipin ogorun rẹ ga ni eniyan pupọ” jẹ otitọ nigbagbogbo; wa ki o ṣalaye apẹẹrẹ ti kii ṣe otitọ.
l-m-e5-b03-04.material: Ẹtọ: Ile-iwe ti ipin akẹkọ ti o wọ gilaasi ga ni akẹkọ gilaasi pupọ. Wa ile-iwe meji ti o tako ẹtọ naa.
l-m-e5-b03-04.s.s1.r.a: O jẹ 40 ati 20, nitorina ipin ogorun ga ni eniyan pupọ.
l-m-e5-b03-04.s.s1.r.b: O jẹ 150 ati 50, nitorina ipin ogorun ga ni eniyan pupọ.
l-m-e5-b03-04.s.s1.r.d: O jẹ 30 ati 20, nitorina ipin ogorun ga ni eniyan pupọ.
l-m-e5-b03-04.s.s1.explain: A jẹ 40%, eniyan 80; B jẹ 20%, eniyan 100. Lapapọ akẹkọ yatọ, nitorina abajade yi pada.
l-m-e5-b03-04.s.s2.model.0: A jẹ 200×0.4=80 eniyan, B jẹ 500×0.2=100 eniyan. Bi A tilẹ ni ipin ogorun ga, B ni eniyan diẹ sii.
l-m-e5-b03-04.s.s2.model.1: Ipin ogorun jẹ ipin ninu odidi; ti apapọ nọmba akẹkọ ba yatọ, nọmba eniyan ati aṣẹ le yatọ.

l-m-e5-b03-05.title: Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ anọ hà nhata, ọ bụ square?
l-m-e5-b03-05.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na quadrilateral nwere akụkụ anọ hà nhata n'ogologo bụ square mgbe niile ọ bụ eziokwu, chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ na-emegide ya).
l-m-e5-b03-05.s.s1.o.b: Rectangle nwere obosara 5 cm na ịdị elu 3 cm
l-m-e5-b03-05.material: Ẹtọ: Onigun mẹrin ti ẹgbẹ mẹrin rẹ dọgba jẹ square. Wa onigun mẹrin ti o fi han pe ẹtọ ko tọ.
l-m-e5-b03-05.s.s1.r.a: O jẹ square, nitorina o ba ẹtọ mu.
l-m-e5-b03-05.s.s1.r.b: Awọn ẹgbẹ mẹrin ko dọgba, nitorina ko le ṣe idanwo ẹtọ naa.

l-m-e5-b03-05.s.s1.o.d: Rectangle iwọn 5 cm ati giga 5 cm
l-m-e5-b03-05.s.s1.r.d: Gbogbo igun mẹrin jẹ igun ọtun, ẹgbẹ mẹrin si dọgba; nitorina o jẹ square.
l-m-e5-b03-05.s.s1.explain: Rhombus ti ẹgbẹ mẹrin dọgba pẹlu igun kan 60° ko ni igun ọtun, nitorina kii ṣe square.
l-m-e5-b03-05.s.s2.model.0: Paapaa ti ẹgbẹ mẹrin ba dọgba, ti igun kan ba jẹ 60° kii ṣe igun ọtun; nitorina kii ṣe square, ẹtọ ko tọ.
l-m-e5-b03-05.s.s2.model.1: Square gbọdọ ni gbogbo igun mẹrin gẹgẹ bi igun ọtun; rhombus ti ko ni igun ọtun jẹ apẹẹrẹ atako.

l-m-e5-b04-01.title: Ti iwọn ba gun ju, ṣe agbegbe ita rectangle naa gun ju?
l-m-e5-b04-01.goal: Ṣayẹwo boya ẹtọ pe rectangle ti iwọn rẹ gun ni agbegbe ita to gun nigbagbogbo jẹ otitọ; wa ki o ṣalaye apẹẹrẹ ti kii ṣe otitọ.
l-m-e5-b04-01.material: Ẹtọ: Ninu rectangle meji, eyi ti iwọn rẹ gun tun ni agbegbe ita to gun. (5×3 tumọ si iwọn 5 cm, giga 3 cm.) Wa tọkọtaya ti ẹtọ ko tọ.
l-m-e5-b04-01.s.s1.prompt: Yan tọkọtaya ti o tako ẹtọ naa.
l-m-e5-b04-01.s.s1.r.a: B ni iwọn to gun ati agbegbe ita to gun, 20; o ba ẹtọ mu.
l-m-e5-b04-01.s.s1.r.c: B ni iwọn to gun ati agbegbe ita to gun, 20; o ba ẹtọ mu.

l-m-e5-b04-09.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta na ọ bụrụ na e nwere nsonaazụ abụọ, ohere abụọ ahụ bụ otu mgbe niile bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere).
l-m-e5-b04-09.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere naanị nsonaazụ abụọ kwere omume, ohere nke nsonaazụ abụọ ahụ bụ otu mgbe niile. Chọta ikpe ebe nkwupụta a ezighị ezi.
l-m-e5-b04-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ikpe na-egosi na nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi?

l-m-e5-b04-09.s.s1.r.a: Isi na ọgwụgwụ nwere otu ohere, ya mere nke a bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-m-e5-b04-09.s.s1.r.b: E nwere kaadị kpakpando 5 na kaadị ọnwa 5, ya mere ohere bụ otu.
l-m-e5-b04-09.s.s1.o.c: Ịtụba dice: ọnụọgụ ọdịnaya ma ọ bụ ọbụna

l-m-e5-b04-09.s.s1.explain: Spinner ahụ nwere blue na 3/4 na yellow na 1/4. Ọbụna na nsonaazụ abụọ, ohere nwere ike ịghara ịbụ otu.
l-m-e5-b04-09.s.s2.model.0: Blue bụ akụkụ 3 n'ime 4, ya mere 3/4, ma yellow bụ 1/4, nke dị iche, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-m-e5-b04-17.s.s1.r.a: Naanị ihe nkesa jikọrọ ọnụ bụ 1, ya mere a pụghị ime ka ọ dị mfe ọzọ.

l-m-e5-b04-33.title: Ọ bụrụ na nchikọta ogologo na obosara ka ukwuu, mpaghara ọ̀ na-abụkwa nnukwu?
l-m-e5-b04-33.topic: Nchikọta ogologo na obosara, na mpaghara
l-m-e5-b04-33.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta “Ọ bụrụ na nchikọta ogologo na obosara ka ukwuu, mpaghara na-abụkwa nnukwu” ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ na-emegide ya.
l-m-e5-b04-33.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe atụnyere akụkụ anọ abụọ, nke nwere nchikọta ogologo na obosara ka ukwuu nwekwara mpaghara ka ukwuu. (4×3 pụtara ogologo 4 cm na obosara 3 cm.) Chọta ụzọ abụọ nkwupụta a na-ezighi ezi.
l-m-e5-b04-33.s.s1.r.a: Nchikọta bụ 7 na 9, mpaghara bụ 12 na 18. B ka ukwuu n'ihe abụọ ahụ, ya mere ọ dabara.
l-m-e5-b04-33.s.s1.r.b: Nchikọta bụ 4 na 7, mpaghara bụ 4 na 10. B ka ukwuu n'ihe abụọ ahụ, ya mere ọ dabara.
l-m-e5-b04-33.s.s1.r.d: Nchikọta bụ 10 na 11, mpaghara bụ 16 na 18. B ka ukwuu n'ihe abụọ ahụ, ya mere ọ dabara.
l-m-e5-b04-33.s.s1.explain: A, 10×1, nwere nchikọta 11 ma mpaghara 10. B, 5×5, nwere nchikọta 10 ma mpaghara 25. N'agbanyeghị na nchikọta ka ukwuu, mpaghara nwere ike ịdị obere.
l-m-e5-b04-33.s.s2.model.0: Nchikọta A, 11, ka ukwuu, ma mpaghara ya bụ 10; nke B bụ nchikọta 10 na mpaghara 25, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ na-emegide ya.
l-m-e5-b04-33.s.s2.model.1: Ka ogologo na obosara na-adịkwu nso, mpaghara na-abawanye, ya mere ọbụna ma nchikọta ka ukwuu, mpaghara nwere ike ịdị obere.

l-m-e5-b05-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “Ọ bụrụ na i tụọ mkpụrụ ego ugboro abụọ, isi na-apụta otu ugboro” ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ na-emegide ya).
l-m-e5-b05-01.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na i tụọ mkpụrụ ego ugboro abụọ, isi ga-apụta opekata mpe otu ugboro. Mgbe e dere nsonaazụ dịka (nke mbụ, nke abụọ), chọta nsonaazụ na-egosi na nkwupụta ahụ bụ ụgha.
l-m-e5-b05-01.s.s1.r.a: Ịtụ nke mbụ nyere isi, ya mere isi pụtara.
l-m-e5-b05-01.s.s1.r.b: Ịtụ nke abụọ nyere isi, ya mere isi pụtara.
l-m-e5-b05-01.s.s1.explain: Ọ ga-ekwe omume ịnweta ọdụ ugboro abụọ. Mgbe ahụ, isi agaghị apụta ma ọlị.
l-m-e5-b05-01.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na nsonaazụ bụ (ọdụ, ọdụ), isi agaghị apụta ma ọlị, ya mere nke a bụ ihe atụ na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-01.s.s2.model.1: Ọdụ nwere ike ịpụta ugboro abụọ, ya mere isi anaghị apụta mgbe niile.

l-m-e5-b05-09.title: Ọnụọgụ ka ukwuu hà nwere ihe nkesa karịa?
l-m-e5-b05-09.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “Ọnụọgụ ka ukwuu nwere ihe nkesa karịa” bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ebe ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ na-emegide ya).
l-m-e5-b05-09.material: Nkwupụta: N’ime ọnụọgụ eke abụọ, nke ka ukwuu nwere ihe nkesa karịa. Chọta ụzọ ọnụọgụ na-eme ka nkwupụta a bụrụ ụgha.
l-m-e5-b05-09.s.s1.r.b: 4 nwere ihe nkesa 3, 6 nwekwara 4, ya mere nke ka ukwuu nwere karịa, nke dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-09.s.s1.r.c: 15 nwere 4, 16 nwere 5, ya mere nke ka ukwuu nwere karịa, nke dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-09.s.s1.r.d: 16 nwere 5, 24 nwere 8, ya mere nke ka ukwuu nwere karịa, nke dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-09.s.s1.explain: 12 nwere ihe nkesa 6, 13 nwekwara ihe nkesa 2. Ọnụọgụ ka ukwuu, 13, nwere ihe nkesa ole na ole.
l-m-e5-b05-09.s.s2.model.0: 13 ka ukwuu karịa 12, ma naanị ihe nkesa ya bụ 1 na 13, ya bụ 2; 12 nwere 6, ya mere nke a bụ ihe atụ na-emegide ya.
l-m-e5-b05-09.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ ka ukwuu nwere ihe nkesa karịa, 13 kwesịrị inwe karịa, ma o nwere ole na ole; ya mere nkwupụta ahụ bụ ụgha.

l-m-e5-b05-17.title: Polygon mgbe niile niile hà bụ ọdịdị nwere point symmetry?
l-m-e5-b05-17.topic: Point symmetry nke polygon mgbe niile
l-m-e5-b05-17.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta 'polygon mgbe niile niile bụ ọdịdị nwere point symmetry' ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ na-abụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ na-emegide ya).
l-m-e5-b05-17.material: Nkwupụta: Polygon mgbe niile niile bụ ọdịdị nwere point symmetry. Ọdịdị point symmetry bụ nke na-adakọ na ọdịdị mbụ mgbe e tụgharịrị ya 180° gburugburu otu isi. Chọta ọdịdị nkwupụta a na-abụghị eziokwu maka ya.
l-m-e5-b05-17.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ polygon mgbe niile na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-17.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-adakọ ọbụna mgbe e tụgharịrị ya 180°, ya mere ọ na-emezu nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-17.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-adakọ ọbụna mgbe e tụgharịrị ya 180°, ya mere ọ na-emezu nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-17.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-adakọ ọbụna mgbe e tụgharịrị ya 180°, ya mere ọ na-emezu nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-17.s.s1.explain: Pentagon mgbe niile nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ akụkụ odd, ya mere mgbe e tụgharịrị ya 180° ọ naghị adakọ na ọdịdị mbụ.
l-m-e5-b05-17.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe e tụgharịrị pentagon mgbe niile 180°, vertices ya anaghị ada n'ebe vertices mbụ dị, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ na-emegide ya.
l-m-e5-b05-17.s.s2.model.1: Polygon mgbe niile nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ akụkụ odd anaghị adakọ mgbe e tụgharịrị ya, ya mere ọ nweghị point symmetry.

l-m-e5-b05-25.title: Pasent ọ̀ pụghị ịgafe 100%?
l-m-e5-b05-25.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "Pasent anaghị agafe 100%" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, mgbe ahụ chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (counterexample).
l-m-e5-b05-25.material: Nkwupụta: Pasent bụ 100% ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị mgbe niile. Chọta ikpe ebe nkwupụta a na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-e5-b05-25.s.s1.r.a: 30/40=75%, nke bụ 100% ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị, ya mere ọ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-m-e5-b05-25.s.s1.r.b: 5/50=10%, nke bụ 100% ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị, ya mere ọ kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta.
l-m-e5-b05-25.s.s1.o.d: Mmadụ 25 n'afọ a tụnyere mmadụ 20 n'afọ gara aga
l-m-e5-b05-25.s.s1.explain: Mmadụ 25 nke afọ a bụ 25/20=125% nke mmadụ 20 nke afọ gara aga. Ọ bụrụ na ọ buru ibu karịa ọnụọgụ ntọala, ọ na-agafe 100%.
l-m-e5-b05-25.s.s2.model.0: 25÷20=1.25, ya mere ọ bụ 125%, nke na-agafe 100%, nke ahụ na-eme ya counterexample.
l-m-e5-b05-25.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ e tụnyere buru ibu karịa ọnụọgụ ntọala, pasent na-aghọ buru ibu karịa 100, ya mere nkwupụta na-ezighị ezi.

l-m-e5-b05-33.title: Ọ bụrụ na nkezi ha bụ otu, ọnụ ọgụgụ uru data hà bụkwa otu?
l-m-e5-b05-33.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “Ọ bụrụ na nkezi ha bụ otu, ọnụ ọgụgụ uru data dịkwa otu” ọ na-abụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ na-egosi na ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ na-emegide ya).
l-m-e5-b05-33.material: Nkwupụta: Ngụkọta data abụọ nwere otu nkezi nwekwara otu ọnụ ọgụgụ uru data. Chọta ụzọ abụọ nke ngụkọta data na-eme ka nkwupụta a bụrụ ụgha.
l-m-e5-b05-33.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ abụọ na-egosi na nkwupụta ahụ bụ ụgha?
l-m-e5-b05-33.s.s1.r.a: Nkezi ha abụọ bụ 6, ọnụ ọgụgụ ha abụọ bụkwa 2, ya mere nke a dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-33.s.s1.r.b: Nkezi ha dị iche, 5 na 6, ya mere nke a enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-33.s.s1.r.d: Nkezi ha dị iche, 6 na 7, ya mere nke a enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-33.s.s1.explain: 4, 6, 8 na 5, 7 nwere nkezi 6, ma ọnụ ọgụgụ ha bụ 3 na 2.
l-m-e5-b05-33.s.s2.model.0: Nkezi ngụkọta data abụọ ahụ bụ 6, ma ọnụ ọgụgụ ha dị iche, 3 na 2, ya mere nke a bụ ihe atụ na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-33.s.s2.model.1: Ngụkọta ha bụ 18 na 12; kewaa nke ọ bụla site n’ọnụọgụ data ya, ha abụọ nweta 6. Ya mere nkezi nwere ike ịdị otu ọbụna ma ọnụ ọgụgụ ha dị iche.

l-m-e5-b0s3-01.topic: Ihe nkesa kasị ukwuu na ndị nkesa
l-m-e5-b0s3-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta “Ihe nkesa kasị ukwuu nke ọnụọgụ abụọ na-adị obere karịa nke pere mpe mgbe niile” ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ na-abụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ na-emegide ya).
l-m-e5-b0s3-01.material: Nkwupụta: Ihe nkesa kasị ukwuu nke ọnụọgụ abụọ na-adị obere karịa nke pere mpe mgbe niile. Chọta ọnụọgụ abụọ na-egosi na nkwupụta a bụ ụgha.
l-m-e5-b0s3-01.s.s1.r.a: Ihe nkesa kasị ukwuu 4 pere mpe karịa 8. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b0s3-01.s.s1.r.b: Ihe nkesa kasị ukwuu 5 pere mpe karịa 10. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b0s3-01.s.s1.r.d: Ihe nkesa kasị ukwuu 3 pere mpe karịa 9. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b0s3-01.s.s1.explain: Ihe nkesa kasị ukwuu nke 7 na 21 bụ 7, nke hà nhata ọnụọgụ nke pere mpe. Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ nke pere mpe bụ ihe nkesa nke nke ka ukwuu, ha abụọ hà nhata.
l-m-e5-b0s3-01.s.s2.model.0: 21 bụ 7 ugboro 3, ya mere 7 bụ nke kacha ukwuu n’ime ndị nkesa ha jikọrọ ọnụ. Ihe nkesa kasị ukwuu 7 hà nhata ọnụọgụ nke pere mpe, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.
l-m-e5-b0s3-01.s.s2.model.1: Ndị nkesa jikọrọ ọnụ nke 7 na 21 bụ naanị 1 na 7, ya mere ihe nkesa kasị ukwuu bụ 7. Ọ dịghị pere mpe karịa ọnụọgụ nke pere mpe, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ bụ ụgha.

l-m-e5-b01-06.s.s1.o.c: Gigun ẹgbẹ to gun julọ nikan
l-m-e5-b01-06.title: Alaye wo ni o nilo gangan lati mọ agbegbe onigun mẹta?
l-m-e5-b01-06.goal: Wa alaye gangan (ofin) ti o ṣe pataki lati wa agbegbe ilẹ onigun mẹta; ṣalaye idi ti o fi yan.
l-m-e5-b01-06.material: O fẹ wa agbegbe ilẹ ti o ni apẹrẹ onigun mẹta. Ronu alaye ti o nilo lati wa agbegbe naa.
l-m-e5-b01-06.s.s1.prompt: Yan alaye ti o ṣe pataki gangan lati wa agbegbe naa.
l-m-e5-b01-06.s.s1.o.a: Iye ti a gba nipa fifi gigun ẹgbẹ mẹta kun (agbegbe ita)
l-m-e5-b01-06.s.s1.r.a: Agbegbe ita nikan ko pinnu apẹrẹ, nitorina iwọ ko le mọ agbegbe.
l-m-e5-b01-06.s.s1.o.b: Gigun ẹgbẹ kan ati giga ti o wa ni igun ọtun si ẹgbẹ naa
l-m-e5-b01-06.s.s1.r.c: Pẹlu ẹgbẹ kan nikan, iwọ ko mọ giga, nitorina o ko le pinnu agbegbe.
l-m-e5-b01-06.s.s1.r.d: Apapọ jẹ 180° nigbagbogbo, nitorina ko fun alaye nipa iwọn.
l-m-e5-b01-06.s.s1.explain: Agbegbe onigun mẹta jẹ ipilẹ×giga÷2. O nilo ipilẹ ati giga ti o wa ni igun ọtun si i.
l-m-e5-b01-06.s.s2.model.0: Agbegbe jẹ ipilẹ×giga÷2, nitorina o nilo lati mọ ipilẹ ati giga. Agbegbe ita le jẹ kanna paapaa ti apẹrẹ yatọ.
l-m-e5-b01-06.s.s2.model.1: Apapọ igun mẹta jẹ 180° nigbagbogbo, nitorina ko sọ agbegbe; o nilo ipilẹ ati giga.

l-m-e5-b01-07.title: Ti o ba kun 2/3, melo ni L ni?
l-m-e5-b01-07.goal: Wa ofin (alaye) gangan ti o ṣe pataki lati mọ iye omi ninu igo, ki o ṣalaye idi ti o fi yan.
l-m-e5-b01-07.material: Igo omi kun omi titi de 2/3. O fẹ sọ iye L omi inu rẹ. Ronu alaye ti o nilo gangan.
l-m-e5-b01-07.s.s1.prompt: Alaye wo ni o nilo gangan lati mọ iye omi (L)?
l-m-e5-b01-07.s.s1.r.a: Awọ ko ni ibatan si iye omi.
l-m-e5-b01-07.s.s1.o.c: Akoko ti o gba lati kun omi
l-m-e5-b01-07.s.s1.r.c: Akoko ko sọ iye L ti igo kikun gba.
l-m-e5-b01-07.s.s1.o.d: Orukọ ile itaja ti o ta igo naa
l-m-e5-b01-07.s.s1.r.d: Orukọ ile itaja ko ni ibatan si iye omi.
l-m-e5-b01-07.s.s1.explain: 2/3 tumọ si 2/3 ti odidi, nitorina o gbọdọ mọ agbara lapapọ lati yi i pada si L.
l-m-e5-b01-07.s.s2.model.0: 2/3 jẹ ipin si odidi, nitorina o gbọdọ mọ agbara lapapọ lati wa iye L.
l-m-e5-b01-07.s.s2.model.1: Ti odidi ba jẹ 6 L, o jẹ 4 L; ti o ba jẹ 9 L, o jẹ 6 L. Iye naa yipada pẹlu odidi, nitorina agbara lapapọ ṣe pataki.

l-m-e5-b01-08.title: Kí ni ofin pinpin lai fi iyokù silẹ?
l-m-e5-b01-08.goal: Wa alaye gangan ti o ṣe pataki lati mọ iye eniyan ti o le pin fun lai si iyokù; ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e5-b01-08.material: O fẹ pin marbles 36 ni dọgba laisi iyokù. Wa ofin ti o pinnu iye eniyan.
l-m-e5-b01-08.s.s1.prompt: Kí ni ofin ti o pinnu iye eniyan ti o le pin fun?
l-m-e5-b01-08.s.s1.r.a: Eniyan 15 jẹ ọpọ 3, ṣugbọn 36÷15 ko pin ni deede.
l-m-e5-b01-08.s.s1.r.b: Eniyan 8 jẹ alafẹ, ṣugbọn 36÷8 ko pin ni deede.
l-m-e5-b01-08.s.s1.r.c: Eniyan 5 kere ju 36 lọ, ṣugbọn marbles ku.
l-m-e5-b01-08.s.s1.explain: Lati pin ni dọgba laisi iyokù, 36 gbọdọ pin ni deede nipasẹ nọmba eniyan. Olupin ni ofin.
l-m-e5-b01-08.s.s2.model.0: 36÷nọmba eniyan gbọdọ pin ni deede, nitorina nọmba eniyan jẹ olupin 36.
l-m-e5-b01-08.s.s2.model.1: 36 ko pin ni deede nipasẹ eniyan 5 tabi 8; nitorina “nọmba kekere” ati “nọmba alafẹ” kii ṣe ofin.

l-m-e5-b01-09.title: Ofin lati ya rhombus kuro ninu parallelogram
l-m-e5-b01-09.topic: Awọn apẹrẹ ti o ni isọdi ila
l-m-e5-b01-09.goal: Wa alaye ti o ṣe pataki lati pinnu boya apẹrẹ kan ni isọdi ila; ṣalaye idi ti o fi yan.
l-m-e5-b01-09.material: Rhombus kan wa, ati parallelogram ti kii ṣe rectangle tabi rhombus. Wa ofin lati pinnu boya apẹrẹ kan ni isọdi ila.
l-m-e5-b01-09.s.s1.prompt: Yan ofin lati mọ boya apẹrẹ kan ni isọdi ila.
l-m-e5-b01-09.s.s1.r.a: Mejeeji ni ẹgbẹ mẹrin, nitorina eyi ko ya wọn sọtọ.
l-m-e5-b01-09.s.s1.r.b: Mejeeji ni ẹgbẹ parallel, nitorina ko ya wọn sọtọ.
l-m-e5-b01-09.s.s1.o.c: Boya igun kan jẹ igun ọtun
l-m-e5-b01-09.s.s1.r.c: Ko si ọkan ti o ni igun ọtun, nitorina ko ya wọn sọtọ.
l-m-e5-b01-09.s.s1.o.d: Boya laini taara kan wa ti o jẹ ki apẹrẹ bo ara rẹ patapata nigba kika
l-m-e5-b01-09.s.s1.explain: Ti laini taara kan (ila isọdi) ba jẹ ki o bo ara rẹ patapata nigba kika, o ni isọdi ila. Rhombus ni iru laini bẹ, parallelogram ko ni.
l-m-e5-b01-09.s.s2.model.0: Ti laini taara kan ba jẹ ki apẹrẹ bo ara rẹ patapata nigba kika, o ni isọdi ila; rhombus ni, parallelogram ko ni.
l-m-e5-b01-09.s.s2.model.1: Nọmba ẹgbẹ ati parallel jọ fun mejeeji, nitorina wọn ko ya wọn sọtọ; ofin ni boya ila isọdi wa.

l-m-e5-b01-10.title: Bawo ni o yẹ ki a fi 0.75 ati 3/5 we?
l-m-e5-b01-10.goal: Wa alaye ti o ṣe pataki gangan lati fi titobi eleemewa ati ida we; ṣalaye idi ti o fi yan.
l-m-e5-b01-10.material: Igo kan ni omi 0.75 L, ekeji ni 3/5 L. O fẹ mọ eyi ti o ni omi diẹ sii.
l-m-e5-b01-10.s.s1.prompt: Ọna wo ni o yẹ lati fi iye meji we?
l-m-e5-b01-10.s.s1.o.a: Fi nọmba oke 3 ati 0.75 nikan we
l-m-e5-b01-10.s.s1.r.a: Nọmba oke tumọ si nkan oriṣiriṣi da lori iye apakan odidi; nitorina a ko le fiwe taara.
l-m-e5-b01-10.s.s1.o.b: Yi mejeeji pada si ọna kanna (eleemewa tabi ida)
l-m-e5-b01-10.s.s1.o.c: Ronu pe eyi ti a kọ ni akọkọ tobi
l-m-e5-b01-10.s.s1.r.c: Ibere kikọ ko ni ibatan si titobi nọmba.
l-m-e5-b01-10.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-eleghara uru ebe anya, ya mere ọ na-ezighi ezi n'ọnụọgụ ndị ọzọ.
l-m-e5-b01-10.s.s1.explain: 0.75=75/100=3/4 na 3/5=0.6. Mgbe ị gbanwere ha n'otu ụdị, 0.75 buru ibu.
l-m-e5-b01-10.s.s2.model.0: Ị nwere ike itụnyere ha site n'itinye 0.75 na 3/5=0.6 n'otu ụdị decimal, ya mere ị chọrọ otu ụdị.
l-m-e5-b01-10.s.s2.model.1: Decimal na akụkụ dị iche n'ọdịdị, ya mere o siri ike itụnyere ha ozugbo, ma naanị mgbe ị gbanwere ha n'otu ụdị ka ị nwere ike ịhụ na 0.75>0.6.

l-m-e5-b03-07.s.s1.r.d: Apapọ ko ni ibatan si giga.
l-m-e5-b03-07.s.s1.explain: Giga ni gigun ti a wọn ni igun ọtun si ipilẹ. Agbegbe jẹ 8×4=32 cm².

l-m-e5-b03-09.title: Ofin lati yan apẹrẹ ti o ni isọdi aarin
l-m-e5-b03-09.topic: Awọn apẹrẹ ti o ni isọdi aarin
l-m-e5-b03-09.goal: Lati wa ofin ti o ya apẹrẹ isọdi aarin sọtọ, pinnu alaye pataki patapata ki o ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e5-b03-09.material: Awọn kaadi onigun mẹta deede, rectangle, parallelogram, ati trapezoid ẹgbẹ meji dọgba wa. O fẹ gba awọn kaadi isọdi aarin nikan.
l-m-e5-b03-09.s.s1.prompt: Kí ni ofin lati yan awọn apẹrẹ isọdi aarin?
l-m-e5-b03-09.s.s1.r.a: Trapezoid ẹgbẹ meji dọgba ni ẹgbẹ mẹrin, ṣugbọn ko ni isọdi aarin.
l-m-e5-b03-09.s.s1.r.b: Rectangle ni isọdi aarin, ṣugbọn gigun ẹgbẹ rẹ yatọ.
l-m-e5-b03-09.s.s1.o.c: Boya o bo atilẹba nigbati a ba yi i 180° yika aaye
l-m-e5-b03-09.s.s1.o.d: Boya o bo nigba kika lẹgbẹẹ ila kan
l-m-e5-b03-09.s.s1.r.d: Onigun mẹta deede bo nigba kika, ṣugbọn ko ni isọdi aarin.
l-m-e5-b03-09.s.s1.explain: Ti o ba bo atilẹba nigbati a ba yi i 180° yika aaye, o ni isọdi aarin. Rectangle ati parallelogram baamu.
l-m-e5-b03-09.s.s2.model.0: Ti o ba bo nigba yiyi 180°, o ni isọdi aarin; nitorina rectangle ati parallelogram nikan ni a yan.
l-m-e5-b03-09.s.s2.model.1: Bibo nigba kika ni ofin isọdi ila; ko le lo lati yan isọdi aarin.

l-m-e5-b03-10.title: Ofin lati pinnu awọn aaye eleemewa ninu ọja
l-m-e5-b03-10.goal: Lati wa nọmba aaye eleemewa ninu ọja eleemewa, pinnu alaye pataki patapata ki o ṣalaye idi ti o fi yan.
l-m-e5-b03-10.material: 0.7×0.9=0.63, 0.2×0.3=0.06, 1.2×0.5=0.60. Wa ofin ti o pinnu nọmba aaye eleemewa ọja. (Ka 0 to ku gẹgẹ bi o ti ri ṣaaju yiyọ rẹ.)
l-m-e5-b03-10.s.s1.prompt: Kí ni ofin ti o pinnu nọmba aaye eleemewa ninu ọja?
l-m-e5-b03-10.s.s1.o.a: Kanna pẹlu nọmba aaye eleemewa ninu nọmba nla julọ
l-m-e5-b03-10.s.s1.r.a: Ninu 0.2×0.3=0.06, mejeeji ni aaye kan ṣugbọn ọja ni aaye meji.
l-m-e5-b03-10.s.s1.o.b: Kanna pẹlu nọmba nọmba ninu apakan odidi
l-m-e5-b03-10.s.s1.r.b: Laibikita apakan odidi, 0.7×0.9=0.63 ni aaye meji.
l-m-e5-b03-10.s.s1.o.c: Apapọ nọmba aaye eleemewa ninu awọn nọmba mejeeji
l-m-e5-b03-10.s.s1.explain: Aaye kan × aaye kan fun aaye meji lapapọ. Ṣafikun nọmba awọn aaye eleemewa ninu awọn nọmba mejeeji.
l-m-e5-b03-10.s.s2.model.0: Kan ṣafikun nọmba awọn aaye eleemewa; aaye kan × aaye kan fun aaye meji.
l-m-e5-b03-10.s.s2.model.1: Ninu 0.2×0.3=0.06, mejeeji ni aaye kan, ọja ni meji; nitorina nọmba aaye ninu eyi ti o tobi julọ kii ṣe ofin.

l-m-e5-b04-02.title: Alaye wo ni o nilo lati wa apapọ?
l-m-e5-b04-02.topic: Alaye ti a nilo lati wa apapọ
l-m-e5-b04-02.goal: Wa ofin (alaye) ti o ṣe pataki patapata lati wa apapọ igbesẹ fun ọjọ kan; ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e5-b04-02.material: A ti kọ nọmba igbesẹ ọjọ meje ti ọsẹ kan. O fẹ wa apapọ igbesẹ fun ọjọ kan. Wa alaye ti o ṣe pataki patapata.
l-m-e5-b04-02.s.s1.prompt: Alaye wo ni o ṣe pataki patapata lati wa apapọ?
l-m-e5-b04-02.s.s1.o.b: Nọmba igbesẹ ni ọjọ ti o pọ julọ ati ti o kere julọ
l-m-e5-b04-02.s.s1.r.b: Pẹlu ọjọ meji nikan, iwọ ko mọ apapọ awọn ọjọ miiran.
l-m-e5-b04-02.s.s1.o.c: Nọmba igbesẹ ni ọjọ ti o ni igbesẹ pupọ julọ
l-m-e5-b04-02.s.s1.r.c: Iye ọjọ kan nikan ko sọ apapọ.
l-m-e5-b04-02.s.s1.explain: Apapọ jẹ apapọ gbogbo rẹ ti a pin nipasẹ nọmba ọjọ; nitorina o nilo apapọ igbesẹ ati nọmba ọjọ.
l-m-e5-b04-02.s.s2.model.0: Apapọ pin apapọ nipasẹ nọmba ọjọ; nitorina apapọ igbesẹ ati nọmba ọjọ ṣe pataki patapata.
l-m-e5-b04-02.s.s2.model.1: Ọjọ kan ti o ni igbesẹ pupọ julọ ko fun apapọ; o nilo apapọ ati nọmba ọjọ.

l-m-e5-b04-10.title: Ịkewa udi nwere otu usoro gburugburu
l-m-e5-b04-10.goal: Chọpụta ọkọlọtọ (ozi) nke dị mkpa kpamkpam iji chọta udi nwere otu usoro gburugburu, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị họọrọ ya.
l-m-e5-b04-10.material: E nwere udi ise: square (akụkụ 5 cm), rectangle (7 cm×3 cm), rectangle (6 cm×5 cm), equilateral triangle (akụkụ 7 cm), na rectangle (8 cm×2 cm). Kewaa ha site n'usoro gburugburu.
l-m-e5-b04-10.s.s1.prompt: Kedu otu nwere udi nke usoro gburugburu ha niile bụ otu?
l-m-e5-b04-10.s.s1.r.b: Usoro gburugburu bụ 20, 22, na 21, nke dị iche ibe ha.
l-m-e5-b04-10.s.s1.r.c: 6×5 nwere usoro gburugburu 22 cm, nke dị iche na 20 cm ndị ọzọ.
l-m-e5-b04-10.s.s1.r.d: Equilateral triangle nwere usoro gburugburu 21 cm, nke dị iche na 20 cm ndị ọzọ.
l-m-e5-b04-10.s.s1.explain: Square bụ 5×4=20, rectangle bụ (7+3)×2=20, ma rectangle bụ (8+2)×2=20.
l-m-e5-b04-10.s.s2.model.0: Udi atọ niile nwere usoro gburugburu 20 cm, ya mere a pụrụ ịkewa ha dị ka nwere otu usoro gburugburu.
l-m-e5-b04-10.s.s2.model.1: 6×5 bụ 22 ma equilateral triangle bụ 21, ya mere abụọ a adịghị n'otu 20 cm.

l-m-e5-b05-34.s.s1.prompt: Kedu otu nwere naanị nha anya ndị ngụkọta ịmụba ha pekarịrị 0.8?
l-m-e5-b05-34.s.s1.r.c: 0.8×1 ka bụ 0.8, ịmụba ya na 1.2 emekwa ka o too.
l-m-e5-b05-34.s.s1.r.d: 0.8×1 ka bụ 0.8, ya mere ọ dịghị ebelata.
l-m-e5-b05-34.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na i jiri ọnụọgụ pekarịrị 1 mụbaa, ngụkọta ahụ ga-adị obere karịa ọnụọgụ mbụ. 0.5 na 0.95 pekarịrị 1.
l-m-e5-b05-34.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ ị na-amụba pekarịrị 1, ngụkọta ya pekarịrị 0.8; ya mere ha bụ nha anya ịmụba na 0.5 na 0.95.
l-m-e5-b05-34.s.s2.model.1: 1 na 1.2 bụ 1 ma ọ bụ karịa, ya mere ngụkọta ahụ bụ 0.8 ma ọ bụ karịa; wepụ ha.

l-m-e5-b0s3-02.title: Ụkpụrụ maka ịhazi mgbakwunye ndị chọrọ denominator jikọrọ ọnụ n’ezie
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.goal: Iji chọta mgbakwunye irighiri ndị chọrọ denominator jikọrọ ọnụ, tụlee ihe ọmụma dị mkpa n’ezie (ụkpụrụ), kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.material: Ị chọrọ ịhazi kaadị mgbakwunye irighiri n’ime “ndị a pụrụ ịgbakwunye ozugbo” na “ndị a ga-ebu ụzọ chọta denominator jikọrọ ọnụ.” Họrọ ụkpụrụ ịhazi ha.
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị bụ ụkpụrụ iji kpebie ma denominator jikọrọ ọnụ dị mkpa?
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma ngụkọta ahụ buru ibu, i nwere ike ịgbakwunye ozugbo ma ọ bụrụ na denominator ha bụ otu.
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.s.s1.o.b: Denominator ha dị iche n’ebe ibe ha nọ?
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụ irighiri kwesịrị ekwesị ka ọ bụ irighiri na-ekwesịghị ekwesị?
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna ma ha bụ irighiri kwesịrị ekwesị, ị ga-achọta denominator jikọrọ ọnụ ma denominator ha dị iche.
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.s.s1.o.d: Numerator ha dị iche n’ebe ibe ha nọ?
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọbụna ma numerator ha dị iche, ọ bụrụ na denominator ha bụ otu, i nwere ike ịgbakwunye ozugbo.
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.s.s1.explain: Denominator ga-abụrịrị otu iji gụọ iberibe nha ha nhata. Ọ bụrụ na denominator dị iche, chọta denominator jikọrọ ọnụ iji mee ka ha kwekọọ.
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe denominator bụ otu, iberibe ha bụ nha otu, i nwere ike ịgbakwunye numerator ozugbo; ya mere denominator bụ ụkpụrụ.
l-m-e5-b0s3-02.s.s2.model.1: Nha numerator ma ọ bụ ngụkọta enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na nha iberibe, ya mere ha abụghị ụkpụrụ iji kpebie ma denominator jikọrọ ọnụ dị mkpa.

l-m-e5-b01-11.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ikpe nke ebe nke akụkụ anọ nwere ogologo+obosara=14 cm, chọta ma kwuo usoro, ma lelee usoro ahụ n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-m-e5-b01-11.material: Ndị a bụ ebe nke akụkụ anọ nke ogologo na obosara ha na-agbakwunye na 14 cm. Ogologo 1, obosara 13 bụ 13, ogologo 2, obosara 12 bụ 24, ogologo 3, obosara 11 bụ 33, na ogologo 4, obosara 10 bụ 40 cm².
l-m-e5-b01-11.s.s1.prompt: Jiri usoro ahụ họrọ ebe maka ogologo 5, obosara 9.

l-m-e5-b01-11.s.s1.r.d: Ọ gbakwunyere mmụba ikpeazụ, 7, dịka ọ dị. Mmụba na-adị obere site na 2.

l-m-e5-b01-13.material: Mgbe a na-eme foto ka ọ buo ibu, (ogologo, obosara) na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ (3, 2), (6, 4), (9, 6), (12, 8) cm. Chọta usoro nke ogologo na obosara na-ebuwanye ọnụ.
l-m-e5-b01-13.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ obosara mgbe ogologo bụ 15 cm.

l-m-e5-b01-13.s.s1.r.d: Ọ gbakwunyere 2 n'ogologo. Ha abụọ na-eto n'otu okpukpu.

l-m-e5-b01-14.material: 0.35×10=3.5, 0.35×100=35, na 0.35×1000=350. Chọta usoro nke otú ebe decimal si ebugharị mgbe ị na-amụba site na 10, 100, na 1000.

l-m-e5-b01-15.s.s1.explain: E nwere bọl 1+9=10 n'ngụkọta ma bọl A 1, ya mere ohere bụ 1/10.

l-m-e5-b02-11.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nchikọta malite na 1/2 ma kewaa ya ọkara oge ọ bụla, wee jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa iwu ahụ.
l-m-e5-b02-11.material: 1/2=1/2, 1/2+1/4=3/4, 1/2+1/4+1/8=7/8, 1/2+1/4+1/8+1/16=15/16. Chọta iwu maka otú nchikọta si agbanwe ka ị na-agbakwunye ihe ọzọ.
l-m-e5-b02-11.s.s1.r.b: Denominator bụ denominator nke okwu ikpeazụ, 32. Ọ bụghị 64.
l-m-e5-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: Nchikọta ahụ na-adị ntakịrị ala karịa 1 mgbe niile. Ọ dịghị mgbe ọ ga-abụ 1.
l-m-e5-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: E were numerator dịka ọnụ ọgụgụ okwu, 5. Numerator dị 1 nta karịa denominator.
l-m-e5-b02-11.s.s1.explain: Numerator nchikọta na-adị 1 nta karịa denominator mgbe niile. Denominator nke okwu ikpeazụ bụ 32, ya mere ọ bụ 31/32.
l-m-e5-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: Denominator nchikọta bụ denominator nke okwu ikpeazụ, numerator dịkwa 1 nta karịa ya, ya mere ọ bụ 31/32.
l-m-e5-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: Dịka 1/2, 3/4, 7/8, 15/16, ọ dị otu okwu ikpeazụ ala karịa 1, ya mere 1−1/32=31/32.

l-m-e5-b02-12.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ mean data sitere n'ịchịkọta ọnụọgụ odd n'usoro, wee jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa iwu ahụ.
l-m-e5-b02-12.material: Mean nke 1, 3 bụ 2; mean nke 1, 3, 5 bụ 3; mean nke 1, 3, 5, 7 bụ 4. Chọta iwu maka mean data e mere site n'ịchịkọta ọnụọgụ odd n'usoro.
l-m-e5-b02-12.s.s1.prompt: Jiri iwu ahụ họrọ mean nke 1, 3, 5, …, 21.
l-m-e5-b02-12.s.s1.r.b: Nke ahụ bụ nchikọta ọnụọgụ mbụ na nke ikpeazụ. Ị ga-ekewa na 2.
l-m-e5-b02-12.s.s1.r.c: A chọtara naanị ọkara ọnụọgụ ikpeazụ. Jirikwa ọnụọgụ mbụ, 1.
l-m-e5-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ ikpeazụ. Mean dị ihe dị ka n'etiti ọnụọgụ mbụ na nke ikpeazụ.
l-m-e5-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Mean dị n'etiti ọnụọgụ mbụ na nke ikpeazụ. (1+21)÷2=11.
l-m-e5-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Mean bụ etiti ọnụọgụ mbụ na nke ikpeazụ, ya mere (1+21)÷2=11.
l-m-e5-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: Maka 1, 3, 5, 7, e mere (1+7)÷2=4. N'otu usoro ahụ, mean ruo 21 bụ 11.

l-m-e5-b02-13.material: 9÷3=3, 9÷0.3=30, 9÷0.03=300. Chọta iwu maka mgbanwe quotient mgbe divisor na-adị ntakịrị.
l-m-e5-b02-13.s.s1.r.b: E tinyere 0 abụọ. Ọ na-abawanye otu ebe oge ọ bụla.

l-m-e5-b02-13.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ quotient maka 0.03. A chọrọ 0 ọzọ.
l-m-e5-b02-13.s.s1.explain: Oge ọ bụla divisor ghọrọ 1/10, quotient na-abụ okpukpu 10. Okpukpu 10 nke 300 bụ 3000.
l-m-e5-b02-13.s.s2.model.0: Oge ọ bụla divisor na-agbada ka ọ bụrụ 1/10, quotient na-abụ okpukpu 10, ya mere mgbe 300 gasịrị bụ 3000.
l-m-e5-b02-13.s.s2.model.1: Quotient maka 0.3 na 0.03 bụ 30 na 300, ya mere maka 0.003 ọ na-abụ 3000.

l-m-e5-b02-14.goal: Chọta ma kwupụta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ mpaghara trapezoid nwere otu ịdị elu, wee jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-e5-b02-14.material: Ọ bụ trapezoid ịdị elu ya bụ 3 cm. Elu 2 na ala 4 na-enye mpaghara 9; elu 3 na ala 5 na-enye 12; elu 4 na ala 6 na-enye 15 cm².
l-m-e5-b02-14.s.s1.prompt: Jiri iwu ahụ họrọ mpaghara mgbe elu bụ 5, ala bụ 7.
l-m-e5-b02-14.s.s1.r.b: E chere na ọ na-abawanye 6, ọ bụghị 3.
l-m-e5-b02-14.s.s1.r.c: Mgbe elu na ala toro ogologo, mpaghara na-abawanye kwa. Ọ na-abawanye 3 oge ọ bụla.
l-m-e5-b02-14.s.s1.explain: Mpaghara 9, 12, 15 na-abawanye 3 oge ọ bụla, ya mere nke na-esote bụ 18. (5+7)×3÷2=18.

l-m-e5-b03-12.s.s1.r.b: I were naanị 10 agbakwunyere dịka mean. I chefuru mean mbụ, 5.
l-m-e5-b03-12.s.s1.r.d: I gbakwụnyere 10 ugboro abụọ. Naanị otu 10 ka a na-agbakwunye na mean.

l-m-e5-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na i gbakwunye 10 na ọnụọgụ nke ọ bụla, 10 na-agbakwụnye na mean kwa, ya mere 5+10=15.
l-m-e5-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: 13+15+17=45, 45÷3=15, ya mere dịka usoro ahụ si dị mean bụ 15.

l-m-e5-b04-11.goal: Chọta ma kwuo usoro site n'ọtụtụ ikpe nke idee unit fraction dị ka nchikota nke fractions abụọ, ma lelee usoro ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-m-e5-b04-11.material: 1/2=1/3+1/6, 1/3=1/4+1/12, na 1/4=1/5+1/20. Chọta usoro ahụ ma dee 1/5 n'otu ụzọ ahụ.
l-m-e5-b04-11.s.s1.r.c: A gbakwunyere denominators dị ka 5+6. Usoro ahụ bụ ngwaahịa.
l-m-e5-b04-11.s.s1.r.d: A mụbara denominator 5 ugboro ugboro ka ọ bụrụ 25.
l-m-e5-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Denominator nke abụọ bụ ngwaahịa nke denominator mbụ n na n+1. 5×6=30, ya mere 1/5=1/6+1/30.
l-m-e5-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: Ngwaahịa nke denominators bụ denominator nke abụọ, ya mere ọ bụ 1/6+1/30, ma ịgbakwunye site na common denominator na-enye 6/30=1/5.

l-m-e5-b05-03.material: Okpokolo agba foto nwere akụkụ anọ nhata nwere ókè obosara 1 cm. Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ mpụta bụ 6 cm, mpaghara ókè ahụ bụ 20 cm²; ma ọ bụrụ 7 cm, ọ bụ 24 cm²; ma ọ bụrụ 8 cm, ọ bụ 28 cm². Chọta usoro dị n’etiti akụkụ mpụta na mpaghara ókè ahụ.

l-m-e5-b05-03.s.s2.model.0: 20, 24 na 28 nke ọ bụla na-abawanye site na 4 mgbe akụkụ ahụ rịrị site na 1, ya mere maka 10 cm ọ bụ 28+4×2=36.

l-m-e5-b05-19.material: Mgbe kaadị 3 nwere ọnụọgụ 1 ruo 3 dị, ohere ịdọta odd bụ 2/3; mgbe kaadị 5 nwere 1 ruo 5 dị, ọ bụ 3/5; mgbe kaadị 7 nwere 1 ruo 7 dị, ọ bụ 4/7. Chọta usoro mgbe ọnụ ọgụgụ kaadị bụ odd.

l-m-e5-b05-19.s.s1.r.b: E nwere kaadị odd 1 ọzọ, ya mere ha abụghị kpọmkwem ọkara na ọkara.
l-m-e5-b05-19.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ohere ịdọta kaadị even.

l-m-e5-b0s3-09.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ mgbanwe uru mgbe a na-amụba ugboro ugboro na 0.1, kwupụta usoro, ma jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nyochaa ya.
l-m-e5-b0s3-09.material: 0.1×0.1=0.01, 0.1×0.01=0.001, 0.1×0.001=0.0001. Chọta usoro mgbanwe uru mgbe a na-amụba ugboro ugboro na 0.1.
l-m-e5-b0s3-09.s.s1.prompt: Iji usoro ahụ, uru 0.1×0.0001 bụ ole?
l-m-e5-b0s3-09.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ otu uru ahụ tupu ịmụba. Ịmụba na 0.1 na-eme ka uru pere mpe.
l-m-e5-b0s3-09.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ uru karịrị 0.0001. Ịmụba kwesịrị ime ka ọ pere mpe.
l-m-e5-b0s3-09.s.s1.r.c: A na-agbakwunye naanị otu ebe decimal. Naanị 0 ọzọ ka a na-etinye.
l-m-e5-b0s3-09.s.s1.explain: Oge ọ bụla a mụbara na 0.1, ebe decimal na-abawanye 1. Mgbe ebe 4 gasịrị, ọ na-abụ 5, ya mere 0.00001.
l-m-e5-b0s3-09.s.s2.model.0: Oge ọ bụla a mụbara na 0.1, ebe decimal na-abawanye 1, site na ebe 4 ruo ebe 5, ya mere 0.00001.
l-m-e5-b0s3-09.s.s2.model.1: Ịmụba na 0.1 na-eme ka uru bụrụ 1/10, ya mere ọ bụ 1/10 nke 0.0001, nke bụ 0.00001.

l-m-e5-b01-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke bụ atụmatụ kwesịrị ekwesị nke ebe ahụ?

l-m-e5-b01-18.s.s1.r.d: Ọ hapụrụ ebe decimal ma tụ anya okpukpu 10 buru ibu.
l-m-e5-b01-18.s.s1.explain: 7.9 dị nso na 8 ma 6.1 dị nso na 6. 8×6=48, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 48 m².
l-m-e5-b01-18.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị were 7.9 dị ka 8 na 6.1 dị ka 6, mgbe ahụ 8×6=48, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 48 m².

l-m-e5-b02-19.s.s1.r.b: A gụrụ 30% dị ka ụmụ akwụkwọ 30.
l-m-e5-b02-19.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ karịrị ọnụọgụ ụmụ akwụkwọ niile nke ukwuu.

l-m-e5-b03-17.goal: Tụọle mpaghara parallelogram iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e5-b03-17.material: E nwere parallelogram nwere isi 9.8 cm na ịdị elu 5.1 cm. Tụọle ihe dị ka cm² ole bụ mpaghara ya.
l-m-e5-b03-17.s.s1.r.a: Nke a dị nso na nchikọta ogologo abụọ ahụ. Ị ga-amụba ha.
l-m-e5-b03-17.s.s1.r.b: I kewara ya ọkara. Maka parallelogram, ị naghị eme ÷2.
l-m-e5-b03-17.s.s1.explain: 9.8 dị nso na 10, 5.1 dị nso na 5. 10×5=50, ya mere ihe dị ka 50 cm².
l-m-e5-b03-17.s.s2.model.0: Were 9.8 dịka 10 na 5.1 dịka 5, 10×5=50, ya mere ihe dị ka 50 cm².
l-m-e5-b03-17.s.s2.model.1: Mpaghara parallelogram bụ isi×ịdị elu. A naghị ekewa ya ọkara, ya mere ọ dị ihe dị ka 50.

l-m-e5-b03-18.title: Ịtụle mkpokọta ibu ihe atọ dị na nkata ịzụ ahịa
l-m-e5-b03-18.goal: Tụọle mkpokọta ibu ihe atọ ahụ iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e5-b03-18.material: N'ime nkata ịzụ ahịa e nwere osikapa 1.98 kg, poteto 3.02 kg, na apụl 4.95 kg. Tụọle ihe dị ka kg ole ha dị n'ozuzu.
l-m-e5-b03-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ mkpokọta ibu dabara adaba?
l-m-e5-b03-18.s.s1.r.a: Ọ dị ka agụpụtara naanị otu ihe. Ị ga-agbakwunye ihe atọ niile.
l-m-e5-b03-18.s.s1.r.c: I mere ka ọnụọgụ ndị ahụ too elu nke ukwuu. Ị nwere ike were ha dịka 2, 3, 5.
l-m-e5-b03-18.s.s1.explain: 1.98 dị nso na 2, 3.02 na 3, 4.95 na 5. 2+3+5=10, ya mere ihe dị ka 10 kg.
l-m-e5-b03-18.s.s2.model.0: Were 1.98 dịka 2, 3.02 dịka 3, 4.95 dịka 5. Nchikọta bụ 10, ya mere ihe dị ka 10 kg.
l-m-e5-b03-18.s.s2.model.1: Onye ọ bụla dị nso na ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị ya nso, ya mere nchikọta dịkwa nso na 10.

l-m-e5-b03-19.goal: Tụọle anya ị ga-aga na mmanụ 1 L iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e5-b03-19.material: Ụgbọala gara 59 km na mmanụ 6 L. Tụọle ihe dị ka km ole ọ ga-aga na 1 L.
l-m-e5-b03-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kwesịrị ekwesị maka anya na 1 L?
l-m-e5-b03-19.s.s1.r.a: 59÷6 karịrị 1 nke ukwuu. Ọ bụ 59 km na 6 L.
l-m-e5-b03-19.s.s1.r.d: I mụbara 59 na 6. Maka 1 L, ị ga-ekewa.
l-m-e5-b03-19.s.s1.explain: 59 dị nso na 60. 60÷6=10, ya mere ihe dị ka 10 km.
l-m-e5-b03-19.s.s2.model.0: Were 59 dịka 60, 60÷6=10, ya mere ọ na-aga ihe dị ka 10 km na 1 L.
l-m-e5-b03-19.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ 59 km na 6 L, ya mere na 1 L ọ dị obere karịa nke ahụ nke ukwuu, ihe dị ka 10 km.

l-m-e5-b03-20.title: Ihe dị ka mita ole bụ otu gburugburu ebe egwuregwu?
l-m-e5-b03-20.goal: Tụọle ogologo otu gburugburu ebe egwuregwu rectangle iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e5-b03-20.material: Ebe egwuregwu rectangle dị 98 m n'obosara na 51 m n'ogologo. Tụọle ihe dị ka mita ole bụ otu gburugburu ya.
l-m-e5-b03-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ dabara adaba maka ogologo otu gburugburu?
l-m-e5-b03-20.s.s1.r.a: I gbakwụnyere obosara na ogologo otu ugboro nke ọ bụla. Otu gburugburu bụ okpukpu 2 nke ahụ.
l-m-e5-b03-20.s.s1.r.c: I mere atụmatụ okpukpu 4. A na-agụta obosara na ogologo ugboro abụọ nke ọ bụla.
l-m-e5-b03-20.s.s1.r.d: I mụbara ya dịka mpaghara. Maka perimeta, ị ga-agbakwunye.
l-m-e5-b03-20.s.s1.explain: 98 dị nso na 100, 51 dị nso na 50. (100+50)×2=300, ya mere ihe dị ka 300 m.
l-m-e5-b03-20.s.s2.model.0: Were 98 dịka 100 na 51 dịka 50, (100+50)×2=300, ya mere ihe dị ka 300 m.
l-m-e5-b03-20.s.s2.model.1: Otu gburugburu na-aga n'obosara na ogologo ugboro abụọ nke ọ bụla, ya mere ọ dị ihe dị ka 300, ya bụ okpukpu 2 nke 150.

l-m-e5-b04-04.title: Iwuwo irin 0.9 m ti ọpa irin ti iwuwo rẹ jẹ 7.8 kg fun 1 m jẹ melo?
l-m-e5-b04-04.goal: Ṣe iṣiro iwuwo 0.9 m ti ọpa irin lati pinnu iwọn to yẹ; ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e5-b04-04.material: 1 m ọpa irin jẹ 7.8 kg. O fẹ wa iwuwo 0.9 m pẹlu 7.8×0.9. Ṣe iṣiro isunmọ ṣaaju iṣiro gangan.
l-m-e5-b04-04.s.s1.prompt: Elo ni iwuwo 0.9 m ni isunmọ?
l-m-e5-b04-04.s.s1.r.b: A gbe aaye eleemewa si ibi ti ko tọ. 1 m jẹ 7.8 kg.
l-m-e5-b04-04.s.s1.r.c: A gbọdọ sọ di pupọ, ṣugbọn a ṣafikun. 0.9 m kuru ju 1 m lọ.
l-m-e5-b04-04.s.s1.r.d: A ṣe iṣiro kere pupọ ju iwuwo 1 m lọ.
l-m-e5-b04-04.s.s1.explain: 0.9 m kuru diẹ ju 1 m lọ, nitorina o jẹ nipa 7 kg, diẹ kere ju 7.8 kg lọ. Iwuwo gangan jẹ 7.02 kg.
l-m-e5-b04-04.s.s2.model.0: 0.9 sunmọ 1, nitorina o kere diẹ ju 7.8×1 lọ, nipa 7 kg.
l-m-e5-b04-04.s.s2.model.1: 1 m jẹ 7.8 kg, 0.9 m si kuru, nitorina nipa 7 kg, kere ju 7.8 lọ, yẹ.

l-m-e5-b04-12.title: Ndị mmeri ole ka a ga-enwe n'ịdọrọ nkwụghachi ụgwọ?
l-m-e5-b04-12.goal: Tụọ ọnụọgụ ndị mmeri iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara gị.
l-m-e5-b04-12.material: E nwere ịdọrọ nkwụghachi ụgwọ ebe ohere imeri n'otu ịdọrọ bụ 0.2. Tụọ n'ihe dị ka ndị mmeri ole ga-adị ma ndị mmadụ 48 dọrọ otu ugboro nke ọ bụla.
l-m-e5-b04-12.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ịtụ kwesịrị ekwesị maka ọnụọgụ ndị mmeri?
l-m-e5-b04-12.s.s1.r.a: A gụrụ 0.2 dị ka 2. 0.2 bụ ihe dị ka mmadụ 1 n'ime 5.
l-m-e5-b04-12.s.s1.r.c: Echere na ohere bụ 1/2 n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-e5-b04-12.s.s1.r.d: Ọ chere na onye ọ bụla na-emeri.
l-m-e5-b04-12.s.s1.explain: Ohere 0.2 bụ mmadụ 1 n'ime 5, ya mere na mmadụ 48, ọ bụ ihe dị ka mmadụ 10, 1/5 nke ihe dị ka 50.
l-m-e5-b04-12.s.s2.model.0: 0.2 bụ 1/5, ma ọ bụrụ na ị were 48 dị ka ihe dị ka 50, 1/5 nke ya bụ 10, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka mmadụ 10.
l-m-e5-b04-12.s.s2.model.1: Ihe dị ka mmadụ 1 n'ime 5 ọ bụla na-emeri, ya mere na mmadụ 48 ọ bụ ihe dị ka mmadụ 10.

l-m-e5-b05-28.material: Ị ga-ekpuchi mgbidi rectangular nke sara 2.9 m ma dị elu 2.1 m site n'square tiles nwere akụkụ 10 cm, n'enweghị oghere. Tụọ atụmatụ tiles ole ka a chọrọ.
l-m-e5-b05-28.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ kwesịrị ekwesị maka ọnụọgụ tiles?
l-m-e5-b05-28.s.s1.r.d: Agbakwunyere m ọnụọgụ ahịrị n'obosara na ọnụọgụ ahịrị n'ala. Ị ghaghị ịmịkọrịta.
l-m-e5-b05-28.s.s1.explain: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka tiles 29 n'obosara na 21 n'ala, ya mere ihe dị ka 30×20=tiles 600. Ọnụọgụ n'ezie bụ 29×21=tiles 609.
l-m-e5-b05-28.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị hụ ahịrị 29 n'obosara na ahịrị 21 n'ala dịka ahịrị 30 na ahịrị 20, mgbe ahụ 30×20=600, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka tiles 600.
l-m-e5-b05-28.s.s2.model.1: Ihe dị ka tiles 30 n'ahịrị ọ bụla na ihe dị ka ahịrị 20 na-eme ihe dị ka tiles 600, ya mere nke ahụ kwesịrị ekwesị.

l-m-e5-b05-36.title: Ọ bụrụ na i wepụta marble ugboro 200, ihe dị ka ugboro ole ka ọ ga-acha uhie uhie?
l-m-e5-b05-36.goal: Tụlee ugboro ole uhie ga-apụta iji kpebie ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ oke dabara adaba, kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-e5-b05-36.material: Igbe nwere marble uhie 3 na marble anụnụ anụnụ 7. Ị na-ewepụta otu, lelee agba ya, tinyeghachi ya, ma mee nke a ugboro 200. Tụlee ihe dị ka ugboro ole uhie ga-apụta.
l-m-e5-b05-36.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ dabara adaba maka ugboro ole uhie ga-apụta?
l-m-e5-b05-36.s.s1.r.a: E mere m atụmatụ ugboro 10 karịa ọnụ ọgụgụ marble, ya bụ 3.
l-m-e5-b05-36.s.s1.r.c: Echere m na uhie na anụnụ anụnụ hà nhata.
l-m-e5-b05-36.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ugboro ole marble anụnụ anụnụ na-apụta.
l-m-e5-b05-36.s.s1.explain: Ohere uhie bụ 3/10, ya mere ihe dị ka 3/10 nke ugboro 200, nke bụ ihe dị ka ugboro 60.
l-m-e5-b05-36.s.s2.model.0: Ohere uhie bụ 3/10, 200×3/10=60, ya mere ọ ga-apụta ihe dị ka ugboro 60.
l-m-e5-b05-36.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-apụta ihe dị ka ugboro 3 n’ime 10; n’ime ugboro 200, nke ji okpukpu 20 karịa, ọ ga-abụ ihe dị ka ugboro 60.

l-m-e5-b0s3-04.goal: Tụọle oke nchikọta 3/8+4/9 dị n'ime iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.

l-m-e5-b01-21.topic: Ịgbakwunye akụkụ nwere ndị na-ekewa dị iche
l-m-e5-b01-21.goal: Soro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ) nke 2/3+1/4 otu n'otu, chọta ebe ọ buru ụzọ gbagwojuru, ma dozie ya.
l-m-e5-b01-21.material: Otu a ka e si dozie 2/3+1/4. ① Jiri 12, ihe a na-ekekọrịta nke ndị na-ekewa 3 na 4, mee ndị na-ekewa ọnụ ② 2/3=6/12, 1/4=3/12 ③ 6/12+3/12=9/12 ④ 9/12=3/4
l-m-e5-b01-21.s.s1.r.a: 12 bụ ihe a na-ekekọrịta nke 3 na 4, ya mere onye na-ekewa ọnụ ziri ezi.
l-m-e5-b01-21.s.s1.r.c: ③ gbakwunyere n'ụzọ ziri ezi site n'iji uru dị n'② eme ya. Ihe na-ezighi ezi bụ ②.
l-m-e5-b01-21.s.s1.r.d: Ibelata 9/12 ka ọ bụrụ 3/4 ziri ezi.
l-m-e5-b01-21.s.s1.explain: 2/3=8/12. Ị ga-amụbarịrị ma onye na-ekewa ma onye dị n'elu site na 4. Mgbe e mere ya n'ụzọ ziri ezi, 8/12+3/12=11/12.
l-m-e5-b01-21.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị mụbaa onye dị n'elu na onye na-ekewa nke 2/3 site na 4, ị na-enweta 8/12, ya mere 6/12 dị n'② ezighi ezi.
l-m-e5-b01-21.s.s2.model.1: Ị ga-amụba numerator site n'otu nọmba ahụ i ji mụbaa denominator, ya mere 2/3=8/12, nchikọta bụ 11/12.

l-m-e5-b01-22.title: Mmejọ mbụ n'ịchọta mpaghara ala nwere ọdịdị L
l-m-e5-b01-22.goal: Soro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara ihe na ihe si na ya pụta) maka mpaghara ala nwere ọdịdị L, chọta ebe mbụ o na-aga na-ezighi ezi, ma dozie ya.
l-m-e5-b01-22.material: Otu a ka e si chọta mpaghara ala nwere ọdịdị L. ① Nnukwu akụkụ anọ 10×8=80 ② Akụkụ anọ efu dị ogologo 4 m, obosara 3 m, ya mere 4+3=7 ③ 80−7=73 ④ Azịza: 73 m²
l-m-e5-b01-22.s.s1.r.c: ③ wepụrụ 7 nke ②. Ihe na-ezighi ezi bụ 7 dị na ②.
l-m-e5-b01-22.s.s1.r.d: ④ bụ nsonaazụ ahịrị bu ya ụzọ. Ọ bụghị ebe mbụ e mere mmejọ.
l-m-e5-b01-22.s.s1.explain: Mpaghara akụkụ anọ efu bụ 4×3=12. Azịza ziri ezi bụ 80−12=68 m².
l-m-e5-b01-22.s.s2.model.0: Mpaghara akụkụ efu bụ ogologo×obosara, ya mere ọ kwesịrị ịbụ 4×3=12, ọ bụghị 4+3.
l-m-e5-b01-22.s.s2.model.1: A gbakwụnyere mgbe a na-achọta mpaghara, ya mere ② ezighị ezi, azịza ziri ezi bụ 80−12=68.

l-m-e5-b01-23.topic: Otutu jikọrọ ọnụ na nke kacha nta
l-m-e5-b01-23.goal: Soro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara ihe na ihe si na ya pụta) maka oge abụọ ga-ezute ọzọ, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-aga na-ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-m-e5-b01-23.material: Ụgbọala bọs na-apụ kwa nkeji 6, ụgbọ oloko ala na-apụ kwa nkeji 8. Chọta oge ha ga-ebu ụzọ pụọ ọnụ ọzọ. ① Chọta otutu jikọrọ ọnụ nke 6 na 8 ② 6×8=48 bụ otutu jikọrọ ọnụ ③ Ya mere ha ga-ezute mbụ mgbe nkeji 48 gasịrị ④ Azịza: nkeji 48

l-m-e5-b01-23.s.s1.r.b: 48 bụ otutu jikọrọ ọnụ nke 6 na 8, ya mere nke ahụ ziri ezi.
l-m-e5-b01-23.s.s1.r.d: ④ bụ nsonaazụ ③. Ọ bụghị ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi.

l-m-e5-b01-23.s.s2.model.0: 48 bụ otutu jikọrọ ọnụ, ma 24 bụkwa otutu jikọrọ ọnụ, ya mere nzukọ mbụ ga-abụ mgbe nke kacha nta, nkeji 24 gasịrị.

l-m-e5-b01-24.goal: Soro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara ihe na ihe si na ya pụta) nke 1.2×0.5, chọta ebe mbụ o na-aga na-ezighi ezi, ma dozie ya.
l-m-e5-b01-24.material: A gbakọrọ 1.2×0.5 otu a. ① Wepụ ntụpọ decimal ma mee 12×5=60 ② 1.2 na 0.5 nke ọ bụla nwere otu ebe decimal ③ Ngwaahịa ahụ nwekwara otu ebe decimal ④ Gụọ otu ebe malite na 60 iji nweta 6.0, azịza 6

l-m-e5-b01-25.goal: Soro ngwọta (ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara ihe na ihe si na ya pụta) maka ọnụ ahịa akpa e belatara 25%, chọta ebe mbụ o na-aga na-ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-m-e5-b01-25.material: Akpa ọnụ ahịa mbụ ya bụ 8000 won, e belatara ya 25%. A chọtara ọnụ ahịa ọhụrụ otu a. ① 25%=25/100=1/4 ② 8000×1/4=2000 ③ Ya mere ọnụ ahịa akpa ahụ bụ 2000 won ④ Azịza: 2000 won
l-m-e5-b01-25.s.s1.r.b: 1/4 nke 8000 = 2000 ziri ezi. Uru a bụ ego e wepụrụ.

l-m-e5-b01-25.s.s2.model.0: 2000 won bụ ego e wepụrụ, ya mere wepụ ya na 8000, kwuo 6000 won.
l-m-e5-b01-25.s.s2.model.1: Uru a chọtara maka 25% bụ ego e wepụrụ, ọ bụghị ọnụ ahịa mgbe mbelata gasịrị, ya mere ③ ezighị ezi, azịza ya bụ 6000 won.

l-m-e5-b02-23.goal: Soro ngwọta maka ịchọta perimeter site n'mpaghara na ogologo, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ iji chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-adighị mma ma dozie ya.
l-m-e5-b02-23.material: A chọtara perimeter nke rectangle nwere mpaghara 36 cm² na ogologo 9 cm dị ka nke a. ① Obosara bụ 36÷9=4 ② Perimeter bụ 9+4=13 ③ Azịza 13 cm

l-m-e5-b02-23.s.s1.r.d: 13 cm bụ naanị nchikota ogologo na obosara, ọ bụghị perimeter.
l-m-e5-b02-23.s.s1.explain: Perimeter bụ (ogologo+obosara)×2. Azịza ziri ezi bụ (9+4)×2=26.
l-m-e5-b02-23.s.s2.model.0: Perimeter chọrọ ogologo na obosara agbakwunyere ugboro abụọ nke ọ bụla, ya mere ọ bụ (9+4)×2=26.

l-m-e5-b03-22.title: Ngwọta oke ndị kwadoro na ndị megidere

l-m-e5-b03-22.material: N'ime mmadụ 40, mmadụ 12 kwadoro, ndị fọdụrụ niile megidere. ①Ndị kwadoro: 12÷40=0.3 ②0.3×100=30%, ya mere 30% kwadoro ③Ndị megidere: 100−12=88% ④Azịza: 30% kwadoro, 88% megidere

l-m-e5-b03-22.s.s1.explain: Oke ndị megidere bụ 70%, ya bụ 100% ewepụrụ 30% nke kwadoro. 12 bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ mmadụ, ya mere i nweghị ike iwepụ ya na pasent.
l-m-e5-b03-22.s.s2.model.0: Iji wepụ na pasent, oke ndị kwadoro ga-abụkwa pasent. Ya mere 100−30=70% bụ oke ndị megidere ziri ezi.

l-m-e5-b03-23.material: Oriọna A na-enwu kwa sekọnd 4, oriọna B kwa sekọnd 6. Mgbe ha mụnyere ọnụ na sekọnd 0, a chọtara ugboro ole ha ga-enwu ọnụ ruo sekọnd 30 otu a. ①Least common multiple nke 4 na 6 bụ 12 ②Ha na-enwu ọnụ kwa sekọnd 12 ③30÷12=2.5, ya mere ugboro 3 ④Azịza: ugboro 3

l-m-e5-b03-23.s.s1.explain: Ha na-enwu ọnụ na sekọnd 12 na 24. Sekọnd 36 agafeela 30, ya mere ọ bụ ugboro 2.

l-m-e5-b03-24.title: Ojoojumọ awọn oju-iwe: laini akọkọ ti ko tọ ninu ojutu apapọ
l-m-e5-b03-24.goal: Tẹle awọn igbesẹ ojutu apapọ oju-iwe ti a ka lojoojumọ, tabi ọna idi ati abajade, ni ọkọọkan; wa ibi akọkọ ti aṣiṣe ki o ṣe atunṣe.
l-m-e5-b03-24.material: Awọn oju-iwe ti a ka ni ọjọ 4 jẹ 20, 0, 30, 10. Eyi ni bi a ṣe wa apapọ lojoojumọ. ① Fi ọjọ ti oju-iwe 0 silẹ ② 20+30+10=60 ③ 60÷3=20 ④ Idahun: oju-iwe 20
l-m-e5-b03-24.s.s1.r.b: 20+30+10=60 jẹ afikun ti o tọ gẹgẹ bi ①.
l-m-e5-b03-24.s.s1.r.c: 60÷3=20 pin ni deede gẹgẹ bi ②.
l-m-e5-b03-24.s.s1.explain: Ọjọ ti a ko ka oju-iwe tun jẹ ọkan ninu ọjọ 4. Pin apapọ 60 nipasẹ ọjọ 4; apapọ jẹ oju-iwe 15.

l-m-e5-b03-24.s.s2.model.1: Fifi ọjọ ti a ko ka silẹ mu apapọ tobi ju gangan lọ, nitorina ① ko tọ.

l-m-e5-b03-25.material: Baagi A ni bọọlu funfun 2 ati dudu 3; baagi B ni funfun 3 ati dudu 6. ① A jẹ 2/5, B jẹ 3/9 ② Pẹlu ipin apapọ, 18/45 ati 15/45 ③ B ni nọmba oke kere, nitorina iṣeeṣe B ga ④ Idahun: B

l-m-e5-b04-13.title: Ngwọta nke chọtara data efu: ebe ọ gabigara ụzọ?
l-m-e5-b04-13.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ngwọta gbasara ichọta data efu site n'avareji, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, otu n'otu, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ, ma dozie ya.
l-m-e5-b04-13.material: Avareji nke ọnụọgụ ise bụ 12, ma anọ n'ime ha bụ 8, 10, 14, na 15. Nke a bụ otu e si chọta ọnụọgụ fọdụrụ. ① Nchikota nke ọnụọgụ anọ bụ 47 ② Nchikota nke ọnụọgụ ise bụ 12×4=48 ③ Ọnụọgụ fọdụrụ bụ 48−47=1
l-m-e5-b04-13.s.s1.o.a: ① Ahịrị nke chọtara nchikota nke ọnụọgụ anọ
l-m-e5-b04-13.s.s1.o.b: ② Ahịrị nke chọtara nchikota nke ọnụọgụ ise
l-m-e5-b04-13.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ahịrị nke chọtara ọnụọgụ fọdụrụ
l-m-e5-b04-13.s.s1.r.c: ③ wepụrụ nke ọma site n'iji ụkpụrụ sitere n'②.
l-m-e5-b04-13.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na ọnụọgụ fọdụrụ bụ 1, avareji enweghị ike ịbụ 12.
l-m-e5-b04-13.s.s1.explain: Avareji nke ọnụọgụ ise bụ 12, ya mere nchikota bụ 12×5=60. Ọnụọgụ fọdụrụ bụ 60−47=13.
l-m-e5-b04-13.s.s2.model.0: E nwere ọnụọgụ ise, ya mere nchikota ga-abụrịrị 12×5=60, ma ọnụọgụ fọdụrụ bụ 60−47=13.
l-m-e5-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ a ga-amụba avareji site na ya bụ ọnụọgụ data, 5, ya mere 12×4 ezighị ezi.

l-m-e5-b04-21.title: Ebee ka ngwọta mpaghara triangle hiere?
l-m-e5-b04-21.goal: Soro ngwọta mpaghara triangle, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ ka i wee chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ hiere.
l-m-e5-b04-21.material: Triangle nwere ntọala 10 cm, ịdị elu 6 cm e ji n’akụkụ kwụ ọtọ tụọ, na akụkụ mkpọda 7 cm. ① Mpaghara = ntọala×ịdị elu÷2 ② Jiri 7 cm dịka ịdị elu ③ 10×7÷2=35 cm²
l-m-e5-b04-21.s.s1.r.a: Usoro mpaghara triangle, ntọala×ịdị elu÷2, ziri ezi.
l-m-e5-b04-21.s.s1.r.d: Ịdị elu ga-abụ 6 cm, nke e tụrụ n’akụkụ kwụ ọtọ na ntọala.
l-m-e5-b04-21.s.s1.explain: Ịdị elu bụ 6 cm, nke e tụrụ n’akụkụ kwụ ọtọ na ntọala. Ngụkọ ziri ezi bụ 10×6÷2=30 cm².
l-m-e5-b04-21.s.s2.model.0: Akụkụ mkpọda abụghị ịdị elu, ya mere jiri ịdị elu kwụ ọtọ 6 cm: 10×6÷2=30 cm².
l-m-e5-b04-21.s.s2.model.1: Ịdị elu ga-adị n’akụkụ kwụ ọtọ na ntọala; ya mere jiri 6, ọ bụghị 7.

l-m-e5-b04-29.title: Ebee ka gburuguru ọdịdị e jikọtara mejọrọ?
l-m-e5-b04-29.goal: Soro ngwọta maka gburuguru ọdịdị e jikọtara, chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-aga na-ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-m-e5-b04-29.material: E tinyere triangle akụkụ hà nhata nwere akụkụ 8 cm n'akụkụ 8 cm nke akụkụ anọ ogologo 8 cm na obosara 5 cm. ① Gburuguru akụkụ anọ: 26 cm ② Gburuguru triangle: 24 cm ③ Gburuguru=26+24=50 cm

l-m-e5-b04-29.s.s1.r.d: Akụkụ jikọtara 8 cm anaghị ahụ site n'èzí.

l-m-e5-b04-29.s.s2.model.0: Akụkụ 8 cm jikọtara adịghị n'akụkụ mpụta, ya mere wepụ ya ugboro abụọ: 26+24−8−8=34 cm.
l-m-e5-b04-29.s.s2.model.1: 50 gụnyekwara akụkụ zoro ezo n'ime, ya mere ③ ezighị ezi, gburuguru ziri ezi bụ 34 cm.

l-m-e5-b04-37.s.s1.r.b: Anya 3 cm site na A' ruo axis ziri ezi.
l-m-e5-b04-37.s.s1.r.d: AA' nwere 3 cm n'akụkụ nke ọ bụla nke axis, ya mere ọ bụghị 3 cm.
l-m-e5-b04-37.s.s1.explain: AA' dị 3 cm n'akụkụ abụọ axis, ya mere 3+3=6 cm.
l-m-e5-b04-37.s.s2.model.0: A na A' dị 3 cm nke ọ bụla site na axis n'akụkụ ndị na-emegiderịta onwe ha, ya mere AA' bụ 3+3=6 cm.
l-m-e5-b04-37.s.s2.model.1: 3 cm bụ naanị anya dị n'otu akụkụ, ya mere ③ nke kwuru na AA' bụ 3 cm ezighị ezi.

l-m-e5-b05-05.title: Ọnụ ahịa e buliri 20% wee wedata 20%: ebee ka njehie dị?
l-m-e5-b05-05.goal: Soro ngwọta ọnụ ahịa e buliri 20% wee wedata 20%, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere.
l-m-e5-b05-05.material: E buliri ọnụ ahịa ihe nke bụ 5000 won site na 20%, wee wedata ya 20% ọzọ. ① Ịbulite 20%: 5000×1.2=6000 won ② Iwedata 20%: 6000−1000=5000 won ③ Ya mere ọ hà ọnụ ahịa mbụ
l-m-e5-b05-05.s.s1.o.a: ① Ahịrị chọtara ọnụ ahịa e buliri
l-m-e5-b05-05.s.s1.r.a: 20% nke 5000 bụ 1000, ya mere 6000 won ziri ezi.
l-m-e5-b05-05.s.s1.o.b: ② Ahịrị chọtara ọnụ ahịa e wedatara
l-m-e5-b05-05.s.s1.r.c: ③ na-esochi uru sitere na ② naanị.
l-m-e5-b05-05.s.s1.r.d: Iwedata 6000 won site na 20% na-enye 4800 won.
l-m-e5-b05-05.s.s1.explain: Mgbe a na-ewedata ya, ntọala bụ 6000 won. 20% nke 6000 bụ 1200 won, ya mere 6000−1200=4800 won.
l-m-e5-b05-05.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe a na-ewedata ya, a ga-ewepụ 20% nke 6000 won, ya bụ 1200 won, ya mere ọ ghọrọ 4800 won, nke dị iche na nke mbụ.
l-m-e5-b05-05.s.s2.model.1: Ntọala bụ 6000 won, ọ bụghị 5000 won; ya mere iwepụ naanị 1000 won na ② bụ njehie.

l-m-e5-b05-13.goal: Soro ngwọta ọnụ ọgụgụ factor nke 36, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, n'usoro; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o mejọrọ.
l-m-e5-b05-13.material: ① 36=1×36=2×18=3×12=4×9=6×6 ② E nwere mkpụrụokwu ịmụba 5, factor 2 n'ime nke ọ bụla ③ Factors bụ 5×2=10

l-m-e5-b05-13.s.s1.o.b: ② Ahịrị kwuru 2 n'ime nke ọ bụla
l-m-e5-b05-13.s.s1.r.c: Ngụkọta 5×2=10 ziri ezi ma ọ bụrụ na i soro ②.
l-m-e5-b05-13.s.s1.r.d: Factors nke 36 bụ 1,2,3,4,6,9,12,18,36, ya mere e nwere 9.
l-m-e5-b05-13.s.s1.explain: 6×6 nwere factor otu naanị, 6. Nha nhata 4 ndị ọzọ na-enye 2 nke ọ bụla, 6×6 na-enye 1. Ya mere 8+1=9.

l-m-e5-b05-13.s.s2.model.1: Nha nhata 4 na-enye factor 2 nke ọ bụla, 6×6 na-enye 1, ya mere e nwere factor 9, 10 ezighị ezi.

l-m-e5-b05-21.goal: Soro ngwọta mean akara ajụjụ, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, n'usoro; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o mejọrọ.
l-m-e5-b05-21.material: N'ajụjụ, mmadụ 3 nwetara akara 1, mmadụ 2 nwetara akara 2, mmadụ 5 nwetara akara 3. A chọtara mean otu a. ①Mkpokọta akara=1×3+2×2+3×5=22 ②E nwere ụdị akara 3, ya mere kewaa na 3 ③Mean=22÷3
l-m-e5-b05-21.s.s1.o.b: ② Ahịrị kpebiri ihe a ga-ekewa na ya
l-m-e5-b05-21.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ahịrị ebe e dere ikewa
l-m-e5-b05-21.s.s1.r.c: ③ e dere ya site n'iji ọnụọgụ e kpebiri n'②.
l-m-e5-b05-21.s.s1.r.d: Akara bụ 1 ruo 3, ma 22÷3 bụ ihe dị ka 7, nke buru oke ibu.
l-m-e5-b05-21.s.s1.explain: A na-achọta nkezi site n'ikewa site n'ọnụọgụ mmadụ. 3+2+5=mmadụ 10, ya mere 22÷10=akara 2.2.
l-m-e5-b05-21.s.s2.model.0: Divisor kwesịrị ịbụ ọnụọgụ mmadụ, 10, ya mere rụzie ya ka ọ bụrụ 22÷10=akara 2.2.
l-m-e5-b05-21.s.s2.model.1: Ị na-ekewa site n'ọnụọgụ mmadụ nwetara akara, ọ bụghị site n'udi akara, ya mere ② na-ezighị ezi.

l-m-e5-b05-29.title: Iwepụ mixed numbers: ebe kedu ngwọta gbagwojuru?
l-m-e5-b05-29.goal: Soro ngwọta nke 3 1/4 − 1 1/2, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ, mgbe ahụ chọta ma rụzie ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru.
l-m-e5-b05-29.material: E dozie 3 1/4 − 1 1/2 dị otú a. ① Ọnụọgụ zuru ezu: 3−1=2 ② Fractions: wepụ nke dị ntakịrị n'nke buru ibu, 1/2−1/4=1/4 ③ Azịza bụ 2 1/4
l-m-e5-b05-29.s.s1.o.a: ① Ahịrị ebe e wepụrụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu
l-m-e5-b05-29.s.s1.o.b: ② Ahịrị ebe e wepụrụ fractions
l-m-e5-b05-29.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ahịrị ebe e dere azịza
l-m-e5-b05-29.s.s1.r.c: ③ e dere ya site n'iji uru sitere n'②, ya mere ③ n'onwe ya na-esochi.
l-m-e5-b05-29.s.s1.explain: Ị pụghị iwepụ 1/2 n'1/4, ya mere gbazinye ọnụọgụ zuru ezu 1. 2 5/4−1 2/4=1 3/4.
l-m-e5-b05-29.s.s2.model.0: Ị ga-ewepụ 1/2 n'fraction dị ntakịrị 1/4, ma gbanwere usoro mgbe e wepụrụ, ya mere ② na-ezighị ezi ma azịza bụ 1 3/4.
l-m-e5-b05-29.s.s2.model.1: A chọrọ ịgbazinye, ya mere gbanwee 3 1/4 ka ọ bụrụ 2 5/4 ma rụzie ya ka ọ bụrụ 2 5/4−1 2/4=1 3/4.

l-m-e5-b05-37.title: Ngwọta ohere kaadị: ebee ka njehie dị?
l-m-e5-b05-37.goal: Soro ngwọta ohere ịdọrọ kaadị nke bụ ọtụtụ 3 ma ọ bụ ọnụọgụ ọbụna, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ; chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o hiere.
l-m-e5-b05-37.material: Ị dọtara otu kaadị n’ime kaadị 10 e dere nọmba 1 ruo 10. ① Ọtụtụ nke 3 bụ 3, 6, 9, ya bụ kaadị 3 ② Nọmba ọbụna bụ 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, ya bụ kaadị 5 ③ Kaadị ndị bụ ọtụtụ nke 3 ma ọ bụ nọmba ọbụna bụ 3+5=8, ya mere ohere ahụ bụ 8/10
l-m-e5-b05-37.s.s1.r.b: Kaadị 5 ndị nwere nọmba ọbụna ziri ezi.
l-m-e5-b05-37.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ahịrị jikọtara ihe abụọ ahụ
l-m-e5-b05-37.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ nọmba ndị e dere na kaadị otu otu, e nwere kaadị 7.
l-m-e5-b05-37.s.s1.explain: 6 dị n’otu abụọ ahụ. Gụọ 6 ahụ jikọtara ọnụ naanị otu ugboro: 3+5−1=7 kaadị, ya mere ohere ahụ bụ 7/10.
l-m-e5-b05-37.s.s2.model.0: 6 bụ ọtụtụ nke 3, ọ bụkwa ọnụọgụ ọbụna, ya mere a gụrụ ya ugboro abụọ. Nke ahụ na-eme ka kaadị bụrụ 7, ohere ya bụkwa 7/10.
l-m-e5-b05-37.s.s2.model.1: A ga-ewepụ kaadị jikọtara ọnụ otu ugboro, ya mere kaadị dị 7, ọ bụghị 8.

l-m-e5-b0s3-05.title: Ime ka 18/24 dị mfe: ahịrị mbụ ezighị ezi
l-m-e5-b0s3-05.topic: Ime ka ụmụ irighiri dị mfe na nke kacha nta
l-m-e5-b0s3-05.goal: Soro ngwọta nke gbanwere 18/24 ka ọ bụrụ ụmụ irighiri dị mfe, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ o mejọrọ.
l-m-e5-b0s3-05.material: E gbanwere 18/24 ka ọ bụrụ ụmụ irighiri dị mfe otu a. ①Common divisors nke 18 na 24 bụ 1, 2, 3, 6 ②Greatest common divisor bụ 6 ③Numerator 18÷6=3, denominator 24÷3=8 ④Azịza 3/8
l-m-e5-b0s3-05.s.s1.r.a: 1, 2, 3, na 6 bụ n'ezie common divisors nke 18 na 24.
l-m-e5-b0s3-05.s.s1.r.d: ④ dere naanị nsonaazụ ③, ya mere ọ bụghị ebe njehie mbụ dị.
l-m-e5-b0s3-05.s.s1.explain: Ị ga-ekewa numerator na denominator na otu ọnụọgụ, 6. 24÷6=4, ya mere 18/24=3/4.
l-m-e5-b0s3-05.s.s2.model.0: E kewara denominator na 3, ọ bụghị 6, ya mere ③ bụ ebe mbụ njehie mere, 24÷6=4 ziri ezi.
l-m-e5-b0s3-05.s.s2.model.1: Nha na-adị otu naanị ma i kewaa numerator na denominator na otu ọnụọgụ. Ya mere azịza ziri ezi bụ 3/4, ọ bụghị 3/8.

l-m-e5-b0s3-10.title: Ịgbanwe 14/40 ka ọ bụrụ pasent: nzọụkwụ mbụ ezighị ezi
l-m-e5-b0s3-10.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta nke na-ede oke ụmụ akwụkwọ yi enyo anya dịka %, chọta nzọụkwụ mbụ ezighị ezi, ma dozie ya.
l-m-e5-b0s3-10.material: N'ime ụmụ akwụkwọ 40 nọ na klas, 14 na-eyi enyo. A chọtara oke ahụ dịka % otu a. ①Ọnụọgụ atụnyere 14, ọnụọgụ ntọala 40 ②14÷40=0.35 ③0.35×100=3.5 ④Azịza 3.5%

l-m-e5-b0s3-10.s.s1.explain: 0.35×100=35. Ibugharị ebe decimal gaa n'aka nri ebe abụọ na-enye 35%.
l-m-e5-b0s3-10.s.s2.model.0: 0.35×100 bụ 35, ma e gbakọrọ ya dịka 3.5, ya mere ③ bụ nzọụkwụ mbụ ezighị ezi.
l-m-e5-b0s3-10.s.s2.model.1: Ebe decimal ga-aga n'aka nri ebe abụọ, ya mere ọ bụ 35%, ọ bụghị 3.5%.

l-m-e5-b03-29.s.s1.r.d: 12 ni olupin 6, ṣugbọn yiyipada iwọn ati giga fun apẹrẹ kanna.

l-m-e5-b04-06.title: Ti eniyan 8 ba pin akara oyinbo 5, iye melo ni ọkọọkan gba?
l-m-e5-b04-06.goal: Ṣe afihan ipin 5÷8 ni ọna miiran (ọrọ iṣiro, tabili, aworan tabi ọrọ), ki o ṣalaye idi ti itumọ kanna.
l-m-e5-b04-06.material: Eniyan 8 pin akara oyinbo kanna 5 ni dọgba laisi iyokù. Kọ ipin eniyan kan gẹgẹ bi 5÷8 ki o tun sọ ọ gẹgẹ bi ida.
l-m-e5-b04-06.s.s1.prompt: Ida wo ni o ni itumọ kanna pẹlu 5÷8?
l-m-e5-b04-06.s.s1.r.a: A kọ olupin ati nọmba ti a pin sẹhin.
l-m-e5-b04-06.s.s1.r.c: A kọ 8−5 gẹgẹ bi nọmba oke.
l-m-e5-b04-06.s.s1.explain: Ipin pipin ni a kọ pẹlu nọmba ti a pin gẹgẹ bi nọmba oke, olupin gẹgẹ bi ipin isalẹ; nitorina o jẹ 5/8.
l-m-e5-b04-06.s.s2.model.0: 5÷8 jẹ ipin 5 ti a pin nipasẹ 8, itumọ kanna ni 5/8, pẹlu nọmba oke 5 ati ipin isalẹ 8.
l-m-e5-b04-06.s.s2.model.1: Nigbati eniyan 8 ba pin akara oyinbo 5, ọkọọkan gba 1/8 ti akara oyinbo 1 ni igba 5, nitorina o jẹ 5/8.

l-m-e5-b04-14.title: Ịgbanwe 0.7×5 ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ nke 0.1
l-m-e5-b04-14.goal: Kwuo 0.7×5 n'udi ọzọ (okwu, tebụl, foto, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-e5-b04-14.material: Ịchọrọ ikwu ụkpụrụ nke 0.7×5 dị ka ọnụọgụ nke 0.1. 0.7 bụ ọnụọgụ nke bụ mpempe 7 nke 0.1.
l-m-e5-b04-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke na-ekwu otu ihe ahụ dị ka 0.7×5 nke ọma?
l-m-e5-b04-14.s.s1.r.a: A gbakwunyere 7 na 5. Ọ bụ otu 5, ya mere ị ga-amụba.
l-m-e5-b04-14.s.s1.r.d: 0.7 bụ mpempe 7 nke 0.1, ya mere nkeji abụghị 0.01.
l-m-e5-b04-14.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụ otu 5 nke mpempe 7 nke 0.1 nke ọ bụla, ya mere mpempe 35 nke 0.1, ma ụkpụrụ bụ 3.5.
l-m-e5-b04-14.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ otu 5 nke mpempe 7 nke 0.1 nke ọ bụla, ya mere 7×5=35 mpempe, nke pụtara mpempe 35 nke 0.1, otu ihe pụtara.
l-m-e5-b04-14.s.s2.model.1: Mpempe 35 nke 0.1 bụ 3.5, ma ịgbakwunye 0.7 ugboro 5 na-enyekwa 3.5, ya mere ọ bụ otu dị ka nke mbụ.

l-m-e5-b04-22.title: Ikwu nkezi dịka “ikesa hà nhata”
l-m-e5-b04-22.goal: Tụgharịa nkezi ụlọ elu blọk anọ ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese ma ọ bụ okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-e5-b04-22.material: Ụlọ elu blọk anọ nwere ịdị elu blọk 3, 7, 5 na 9. Gbalịa ịkọwa nkezi dịka “uru e nwetara site n’ịkwagharị blọk n’ụzọ hà nhata ka ịdị elu niile kwekọọ.”
l-m-e5-b04-22.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na ị kesaa ha hà, blọk ole ka ụlọ elu nke ọ bụla ga-enwe?
l-m-e5-b04-22.s.s1.r.a: Agụpụtara naanị ụlọ elu atọ. A ga-eji ụlọ elu anọ niile.
l-m-e5-b04-22.s.s1.r.c: E kpebiri ya site n’ụfọdụ uru ụlọ elu naanị. A ga-ekewa ngụkọta site na 4.
l-m-e5-b04-22.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ ngụkọta. A ga-ekewa ya site na 4, ọnụ ọgụgụ ụlọ elu.
l-m-e5-b04-22.s.s1.explain: E nwere blọk 24 n’ozuzu na ụlọ elu 4, ya mere ikesa ha hà nhata na-enye 24÷4=blọk 6 nke ọ bụla.
l-m-e5-b04-22.s.s2.model.0: A na-ekesa ngụkọta blọk, 3+7+5+9=24, hà nhata n’etiti ụlọ elu anọ, ya mere nkezi bụ blọk 6.
l-m-e5-b04-22.s.s2.model.1: Ịkwaga blọk site n’ụlọ elu toro ogologo gaa n’ ndị dị mkpụmkpụ na-eme ka ụlọ elu nke ọ bụla nwee blọk 6, ya mere o nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara na nkezi.

l-m-e5-b04-30.title: Iji akụkụ anọ kọwaa mpaghara triangle
l-m-e5-b04-30.goal: Gbanwee mpaghara triangle gaa n'ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-e5-b04-30.material: Mpaghara triangle nwere ntọala 8 cm na ịdị elu 5 cm bụ 8×5÷2=20 cm². Jikọta nke a na akụkụ anọ ogologo 8 cm na obosara 5 cm.
l-m-e5-b04-30.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkwupụta na-ekwu otu ihe nke ọma?
l-m-e5-b04-30.s.s1.o.a: Ọ bụ okpukpu 2 nke mpaghara akụkụ anọ ahụ
l-m-e5-b04-30.s.s1.r.a: Triangle dị obere karịa akụkụ anọ, ma nkwupụta a kwuru okpukpu 2.
l-m-e5-b04-30.s.s1.o.b: Ọ hà na mpaghara akụkụ anọ ahụ
l-m-e5-b04-30.s.s1.r.b: Mpaghara akụkụ anọ ahụ bụ 40 cm², triangle bụ 20 cm².
l-m-e5-b04-30.s.s1.o.c: Ọ hà na akụkụ anọ nwere akụkụ 5 cm
l-m-e5-b04-30.s.s1.r.c: Mpaghara akụkụ anọ hà nhata bụ 25 cm², nke dị iche.
l-m-e5-b04-30.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụ ọkara mpaghara akụkụ anọ ahụ
l-m-e5-b04-30.s.s1.explain: Akụkụ anọ ahụ bụ 8×5=40 cm², triangle bụ ọkara ya, 20 cm².
l-m-e5-b04-30.s.s2.model.0: Mpaghara triangle 8×5÷2 bụ ọkara nke akụkụ anọ 8×5, ya mere ha pụtara otu ihe.
l-m-e5-b04-30.s.s2.model.1: Ọkara nke 40 nke akụkụ anọ ahụ bụ 20, nke hà na mpaghara triangle, ya mere ị nwere ike ịsị na ọ bụ ọkara.

l-m-e5-b04-38.title: Iji isi ihe kwekọrọ kọwaa nha ntụpọ
l-m-e5-b04-38.goal: Gbanwee isi ihe kwekọrọ n'ọdịdị nwere nha ntụpọ gaa n'ụdị ọzọ (ngosipụta, tebụl, eserese, okwu), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe.
l-m-e5-b04-38.material: Ọdịdị nwere nha ntụpọ bụ ọdịdị nke dabara n'elu nke mbụ mgbe e tụgharịrị ya 180° gburugburu otu ntụpọ (etiti nha ntụpọ). Gbanwee nkọwa a n'okwu isi ihe kwekọrọ.
l-m-e5-b04-38.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkwupụta na-ekwu otu ihe nke ọma?
l-m-e5-b04-38.s.s1.o.a: Akụkụ ahịrị jikọtara isi ihe kwekọrọ kwụ ọtọ n'akụkụ axis nha ahịrị
l-m-e5-b04-38.s.s1.r.a: Axis nha bụ nke ọdịdị nwere nha ahịrị.
l-m-e5-b04-38.s.s1.o.b: Etiti nha ntụpọ ga-adị n'èzí ọdịdị ahụ
l-m-e5-b04-38.s.s1.r.b: Etiti ahụ nwere ike ịdị n'ime ọdịdị ahụ.
l-m-e5-b04-38.s.s1.o.c: Isi ihe kwekọrọ dị anya dị iche iche site n'etiti
l-m-e5-b04-38.s.s1.r.c: Isi ihe kwekọrọ dị otu anya site n'etiti.
l-m-e5-b04-38.s.s1.o.d: Etiti akụkụ ahịrị jikọtara isi ihe kwekọrọ bụ etiti nha ntụpọ
l-m-e5-b04-38.s.s1.explain: Mgbe e tụgharịrị 180°, isi ihe kwekọrọ na-adaba n'otu anya n'akụkụ nke ọzọ nke etiti, ya mere etiti ahụ bụ etiti akụkụ ahịrị jikọtara ha.
l-m-e5-b04-38.s.s2.model.0: Isi ihe kwekọrọ dị otu anya site n'etiti, nọkwa n'ahịrị kwụ ọtọ ya na ya, ya mere etiti ahụ bụ etiti akụkụ ahịrị.
l-m-e5-b04-38.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-adaba mgbe e tụgharịrị 180°, ya mere etiti akụkụ ahịrị jikọtara isi ihe kwekọrọ bụ etiti nha ntụpọ.

l-m-e5-b05-06.title: Ikwu ihe e ji amata ọdịdị nwere akara ngosi ahịrị n’okwu ọzọ
l-m-e5-b05-06.goal: Tụgharịa ihe e ji amata ọdịdị nwere akara ngosi ahịrị gaa n’ụdị ọzọ (okwu, tebụl, eserese ma ọ bụ nkọwa), kọwaa ihe mere ha ji nwee otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-m-e5-b05-06.material: Ọdịdị nwere akara ngosi ahịrị bụ ọdịdị na-ejikọta onwe ya kpamkpam mgbe a tụgharịrị ya n’akụkụ axis akara ngosi ya. Gbalịa idegharị nke a site n’akụkụ kwekọrọ na akụkụ dị n’akụkụ kwekọrọ.
l-m-e5-b05-06.s.s1.o.a: Ogologo akụkụ kwekọrọ na nha akụkụ kwekọrọ hà nhata n’otu n’otu
l-m-e5-b05-06.s.s1.o.b: Naanị ogologo akụkụ kwekọrọ hà nhata, akụkụ ndị ahụ nwere ike ịdị iche
l-m-e5-b05-06.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na ha jikọtara ọnụ, nha akụkụ kwekọrọ ga-abụrịrịkwa otu.
l-m-e5-b05-06.s.s1.o.c: Ahịrị jikọtara isi kwekọrọ niile na-ezukọta n’otu ebe
l-m-e5-b05-06.s.s1.r.c: N’akara ngosi ahịrị, ha na-agakọ n’akụkụ yiri ibe ha. Izukọta n’otu ebe bụ akara ngosi isi.
l-m-e5-b05-06.s.s1.o.d: Anya dị n’etiti isi kwekọrọ niile hà nhata
l-m-e5-b05-06.s.s1.r.d: Anya dị n’etiti isi kwekọrọ na-adị iche maka isi nke ọ bụla.
l-m-e5-b05-06.s.s1.explain: Mgbe a tụgharịrị ha ka ha jikọta ọnụ, ogologo akụkụ kwekọrọ na nha akụkụ kwekọrọ hà nhata n’otu n’otu.
l-m-e5-b05-06.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe a tụgharịrị ha, ha jikọtara kpamkpam, ya mere a pụrụ ikwu ya n’ụzọ ọzọ: ogologo akụkụ kwekọrọ na nha akụkụ kwekọrọ hà nhata.
l-m-e5-b05-06.s.s2.model.1: Akụkụ na akụkụ ndị jikọtara ọnụ nwere ogologo na nha hà nhata, ya mere nkwupụta abụọ ahụ nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara.

l-m-e5-b05-14.title: Ịgbanwe decimal 0.35 ka ọ bụrụ ụmụ irighiri
l-m-e5-b05-14.goal: Gbanwee decimal 0.35 ka ọ bụrụ ụdị ọzọ (mkpụrụokwu ngụkọta, tebụl, foto, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ha ji pụta otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-14.material: 0.35 bụ ọnụọgụ nwere ebe decimal abụọ. Gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ ụmụ irighiri, mee ka ọ dị mfe dịka o kwere mee.
l-m-e5-b05-14.s.s1.r.b: E dere 1000 dịka denominator n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi.
l-m-e5-b05-14.s.s1.r.c: O nwere ebe decimal abụọ, ya mere denominator bụ 100.
l-m-e5-b05-14.s.s1.explain: 0.35=35/100, ime ka ọ dị mfe site na 5 na-enye 7/20.
l-m-e5-b05-14.s.s2.model.0: 0.35 bụ 35 n'ime 100, ya mere 35/100; ikewa abụọ ahụ na 5 na-enye 7/20.
l-m-e5-b05-14.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na i mee denominator nke 7/20 ka ọ bụrụ 100, ị ga-enweta 35/100, otu ọnụọgụ ahụ dịka 0.35.

l-m-e5-b05-22.title: Ikwu 3/4 awa n'nkeji
l-m-e5-b05-22.goal: Gbanwee 3/4 awa ka ọ bụrụ udi ọzọ (nha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ha pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-22.material: I mere mmega ahụ 3/4 awa. Awa 1 bụ nkeji 60. Ka anyị kwuo otu oge ahụ n'nkeji.
l-m-e5-b05-22.s.s1.prompt: Nkeji ole bụ otu ihe ahụ dịka 3/4 awa?
l-m-e5-b05-22.s.s1.r.b: Agụrụ m numerator na denominator ọnụ dịka otu ọnụọgụ.
l-m-e5-b05-22.s.s1.r.d: Agụrụ m 3/4 awa n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi dịka ihe dị ka awa 1 nkeji 15.
l-m-e5-b05-22.s.s1.explain: 1/4 nke awa 1 bụ nkeji 15, ya mere 3/4 awa bụ 15×3=nkeji 45.
l-m-e5-b05-22.s.s2.model.0: 1/4 nke nkeji 60 bụ nkeji 15, ya mere 3/4 awa bụ 15×3=nkeji 45.
l-m-e5-b05-22.s.s2.model.1: 60×3/4=45, ya mere 3/4 awa na nkeji 45 bụ otu oge.

l-m-e5-b05-30.title: Ikwu ihe common divisor pụtara n'okwu
l-m-e5-b05-30.goal: Gbanwee "common divisor" ka ọ bụrụ udi ọzọ (nha, tebụl, eserese, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ha pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-30.material: Common divisors nke 12 na 18 bụ 1, 2, 3, na 6. Ka anyị gbanwee okwu "common divisor" site n'okwu ndị ọzọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-30.s.s1.prompt: Nkwuwa okwu kedu pụtara otu ihe ahụ dịka common divisor?
l-m-e5-b05-30.s.s1.o.a: Ọnụọgụ nke na-ekewa ma 12 ma 18 nha nha
l-m-e5-b05-30.s.s1.o.b: Ọnụọgụ ị na-enweta site n'ịmịkọrịta 12 na 18
l-m-e5-b05-30.s.s1.r.b: Ngwaahịa abụghị common divisor, ọ bụ ngwaahịa nke ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ.
l-m-e5-b05-30.s.s1.o.c: Ọnụọgụ nke na-ekewa naanị otu n'12 ma ọ bụ 18
l-m-e5-b05-30.s.s1.r.c: Common divisor ga-ekewa ma ọnụọgụ abụọ.
l-m-e5-b05-30.s.s1.o.d: Kacha ntakịrị n'etiti multiples nke 12 na 18
l-m-e5-b05-30.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ na-akọwa least common multiple.
l-m-e5-b05-30.s.s1.explain: Common divisor bụ divisor nke ọnụọgụ abụọ na-ekekọrọ. Ọ bụ ọnụọgụ nke na-ekewa ma ọnụọgụ abụọ nha nha.
l-m-e5-b05-30.s.s2.model.0: 1, 2, 3, na 6 na-ekewa ma 12 ma 18 nha nha, ya mere common divisor pụtara ọnụọgụ nke na-ekewa ma ọnụọgụ abụọ.
l-m-e5-b05-30.s.s2.model.1: Common divisor dị n'divisors nke ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ, ya mere ọ bụ otu ihe ahụ dịka ọnụọgụ nke na-ekewa abụọ nha nha.

l-m-e5-b05-38.material: Ohere ihe ime bụ 2/5. Ka anyị kwuo ohere a dịka ntụpọ na dịka pasent.
l-m-e5-b05-38.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke na-egosi otu ohere ahụ dịka 2/5?

l-m-e5-b04-07.title: Ewo ni o tobi, parallelogram tabi rectangle?
l-m-e5-b04-07.goal: Fi ọna tabi ẹtọ meji nipa agbegbe parallelogram ati rectangle we; yan eyi ti o dara julọ ki o ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e5-b04-07.material: (A) rectangle kan ni iwọn 9 cm ati giga 4 cm; (B) parallelogram kan ni ipilẹ 9 cm, giga 4 cm ati ẹgbẹ didan 5 cm. Ewo ni o tobi?
l-m-e5-b04-07.s.s1.o.a: B, n'ihi na akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ dị ogologo karịa na 5 cm
l-m-e5-b04-07.s.s1.r.a: Nha ebe (area) na-ekpebi site n'isi na ịdị elu, ọ bụghị site n'akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ.
l-m-e5-b04-07.s.s1.o.b: A, ọ buru ibu karịa n'ihi na ọ nwere akụkụ ziri ezi
l-m-e5-b04-07.s.s1.r.b: Nha ebe na-ekpebi site n'isi na ịdị elu, ọ bụghị site n'ịbụ na e nwere akụkụ ziri ezi.
l-m-e5-b04-07.s.s1.o.d: Enweghị ike ịmata, udi dị iche
l-m-e5-b04-07.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na ị maara isi na ịdị elu, ị pụrụ ichọta nha ebe.
l-m-e5-b04-07.s.s1.explain: Nha ebe nke parallelogram bụ isi×ịdị elu=9×4=36 cm², nke bụ otu dị ka 36 cm² nke rectangle.
l-m-e5-b04-07.s.s2.model.0: Udi abụọ ahụ nwere isi 9 na ịdị elu 4, ya mere nha ebe bụ otu, 9×4=36.
l-m-e5-b04-07.s.s2.model.1: A naghị eji akụkụ gbagọrọ agbagọ maka nha ebe, ya mere parallelogram bụkwa 36 cm².

l-m-e5-b04-15.title: Ụlọ ahịa nwere ngụkọta buru ibu ọ̀ na-eme nke ọma karịa?
l-m-e5-b04-15.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ọnụọgụ ndị ahịa kwa ụbọchị n'ụlọ ahịa abụọ, họrọ nke ka kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara gị.
l-m-e5-b04-15.material: Bakery A nwere ndị ahịa 350 n'ozuzu n'ụbọchị 7, ma bakery B nwere ndị ahịa 450 n'ozuzu n'ụbọchị 10. Kedu ụlọ ahịa nwere ndị ahịa karịa kwa ụbọchị?

l-m-e5-b04-15.s.s1.r.a: Ọnụọgụ ụbọchị dị iche, ya mere ị nweghị ike ịtụnyere site na ngụkọta naanị.
l-m-e5-b04-15.s.s1.o.b: A, n'ihi na avareji kwa ụbọchị nke 50 buru ibu karịa 45
l-m-e5-b04-15.s.s1.o.c: Otu, n'ihi na abụọ nwere ọtụtụ ndị ahịa
l-m-e5-b04-15.s.s1.o.d: B, n'ihi na ọ meghere ụbọchị karịa
l-m-e5-b04-15.s.s1.r.d: Ụbọchị karịa apụtaghị ndị ahịa karịa kwa ụbọchị.

l-m-e5-b04-23.material: E kewara spinner ndị a ka ọ bụrụ akụkụ hà nhata. Spinner A nwere akụkụ odo 3 n’ime 8, Spinner B nwere akụkụ odo 2 n’ime 5. Kedu nke nwere ohere ka ukwuu ịdakwasị odo?

l-m-e5-b04-39.material: Ndị a bụ ubi ifuru akụkụ anọ nwere otu mpaghara, 64 m². Ubi A dị ogologo 8 m na obosara 8 m, ubi B dị ogologo 16 m na obosara 4 m. Chọta nke nwere oke dị mkpụmkpụ.
l-m-e5-b04-39.s.s1.o.a: B, perimeter ya dị mkpụmkpụ n’ihi na ogologo akụkụ ya ka ukwuu
l-m-e5-b04-39.s.s1.r.a: Ka ogologo akụkụ na-abawanye, perimeter na-adị ogologo. B bụ 40 m.
l-m-e5-b04-39.s.s1.o.b: Ha hà, n’ihi na mpaghara ha hà
l-m-e5-b04-39.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna ma mpaghara ha hà, perimeter ha dị iche: 32 m na 40 m.
l-m-e5-b04-39.s.s1.o.c: B, n’ihi na obosara ya dị mkpụmkpụ, 4 m
l-m-e5-b04-39.s.s1.r.c: Naanị n’ihi na otu akụkụ dị mkpụmkpụ apụtaghị na perimeter dị mkpụmkpụ.
l-m-e5-b04-39.s.s1.o.d: A, n’ihi na perimeter ya dị mkpụmkpụ, 32 m
l-m-e5-b04-39.s.s1.explain: Perimeter A bụ (8+8)×2=32 m, perimeter B bụkwa (16+4)×2=40 m.
l-m-e5-b04-39.s.s2.model.0: A bụ (8+8)×2=32 m, B bụkwa (16+4)×2=40 m, ya mere perimeter A dị mkpụmkpụ.

l-m-e5-b05-07.s.s1.r.c: Ị nwere ike igosi na B bụ ụgha site n’ọnụọgụ dịka 12.

l-m-e5-b05-31.title: Regular triangle ọ̀ bụ point-symmetric?
l-m-e5-b05-31.goal: Tụnyere usoro abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ banyere ma regular triangle bụ point-symmetric, họrọ nke kwesịrị ekwesị karịa, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-m-e5-b05-31.material: Figure point-symmetric bụ figure nke na-ekpuchi nke mbụ mgbe a tụgharịrị 180° gburugburu ebe. Mmadụ abụọ na-ekwu ihe dị iche banyere regular triangle.
l-m-e5-b05-31.s.s1.prompt: Nkwupụta kedu bụ nke kwere nkwenye karịa?
l-m-e5-b05-31.s.s1.o.a: Ọ bụghị point-symmetric, n'ihi na ọ naghị ekpuchi mgbe a tụgharịrị 180°
l-m-e5-b05-31.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụghị point-symmetric, n'ihi na ọ nwere naanị akụkụ 3
l-m-e5-b05-31.s.s1.r.b: Kpebie site n'udi mgbe ntụgharị 180° gasịrị, ọ bụghị site n'ọnụọgụ akụkụ.
l-m-e5-b05-31.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụ point-symmetric, n'ihi na ọ nwere lines of symmetry 3
l-m-e5-b05-31.s.s1.r.c: Lines of symmetry metụtara line symmetry.
l-m-e5-b05-31.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụ point-symmetric, n'ihi na ọ na-ekpuchi mgbe a tụgharịrị 120°
l-m-e5-b05-31.s.s1.r.d: Anyị na-ekwu point-symmetric naanị mgbe ọ na-ekpuchi mgbe ntụgharị 180° gasịrị.
l-m-e5-b05-31.s.s1.explain: Mgbe a tụgharịrị regular triangle 180°, vertices ya na-aga n'akụkụ nke ọzọ ma ọ naghị ekpuchi nke mbụ.
l-m-e5-b05-31.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe a tụgharịrị 180°, vertex na-atụ aka n'ala ma ọ naghị ekpuchi, ya mere ọ bụghị point-symmetric.

l-m-e5-b0s3-07.goal: Mgbe isi triangle gbanwere, tụlee ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta, họrọ nke dabara adaba, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-m-e5-b0s3-07.material: Mgbe isi triangle bụ 6 cm, ịdị elu bụ 4 cm. Kedu ka anyị ga-esi chọta ịdị elu ma ọ bụrụ na e jiri akụkụ ọzọ, 8 cm, dịka isi? A: Ịdị elu ka bụ 4 cm. B: Mpaghara 12 cm² ka bụ otu, ya mere 12×2÷8=3 cm.
l-m-e5-b0s3-07.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ịdị elu ziri ezi mgbe isi bụ 8 cm?
l-m-e5-b0s3-07.s.s1.o.a: A: Ịdị elu ka bụ 4 cm
l-m-e5-b0s3-07.s.s1.r.a: Mgbe isi gbanwere, ịdị elu nke na-enye otu mpaghara na-agbanwekwa.
l-m-e5-b0s3-07.s.s1.r.b: Mpaghara bụ 12 cm² mgbe niile, ya mere a pụrụ ịchọta ịdị elu.
l-m-e5-b0s3-07.s.s1.o.c: B: Chọta ya site na mpaghara: 3 cm
l-m-e5-b0s3-07.s.s1.o.d: Isi toro ogologo, ya mere ịdị elu bụkwa 6 cm
l-m-e5-b0s3-07.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe isi toro ogologo, ịdị elu na-adị mkpụmkpụ iji debe otu mpaghara ahụ.

l-m-e5-b0s3-07.s.s2.model.0: Mpaghara triangle na-adị 12 cm², ebe 8×ịdị elu÷2=12, ịdị elu bụ 3 cm.

l-m-e5-b01-36.s.s1.explain: Eso 3000 won ati ipanu 2000 won jẹ 5000 won, wọn si pade gbogbo ipo. O ni eso pupọ julọ.
l-m-e5-b01-36.s.s2.model.0: O gbọdọ fi o kere ju 2000 won silẹ fun ipanu; nitorina eso le jẹ 3000 won pupọ julọ, iyẹn jẹ 60%, o si ba ipo mu.
l-m-e5-b01-36.s.s2.model.1: Eso 3500 won fi ipanu 1500 won silẹ, nitorina ko gba laaye. 3000 won ni o pọ julọ ti o ba awọn ipo mu.

l-m-e5-b01-39.s.s1.r.b: Iyẹn jẹ ago 2/3, kere ju ago 3/4 lọ.

l-m-e5-b01-39.s.s1.o.d: Ago 1/2 ni igba 1 ati ago 1/4 ni igba 1
l-m-e5-b01-39.s.s1.explain: 1/2+1/4=3/4, o si pari pẹlu iṣẹ ṣiṣe 2. Ago 1/4 ni igba 3 naa jẹ deede ṣugbọn o nilo iṣẹ ṣiṣe 3.

l-m-e5-b01-40.title: Apẹrẹ ami: eyi ti o pade ipo mejeeji
l-m-e5-b01-40.goal: Wo gbogbo awọn ipo ti o tako ara wọn fun ami ti o ni isọdi ila ṣugbọn ko ni isọdi aarin; yan adehun to dara ki o ṣalaye idi rẹ.
l-m-e5-b01-40.material: Apẹrẹ ami tuntun gbọdọ ni isọdi ila ṣugbọn kii ṣe isọdi aarin, o si gbọdọ ni o kere ju ila isọdi 2. Yan apẹrẹ to ba awọn ipo mu.
l-m-e5-b01-40.s.s1.prompt: Apẹrẹ wo ni o pade ipo gbogbo?
l-m-e5-b01-40.s.s1.r.a: O ni ila isọdi 4 ṣugbọn o tun ni isọdi aarin.
l-m-e5-b01-40.s.s1.r.b: O ni ila isọdi 2 ṣugbọn o tun ni isọdi aarin.
l-m-e5-b01-40.s.s1.o.c: Onigun mẹta ẹgbẹ meji dọgba (kii ṣe equilateral)
l-m-e5-b01-40.s.s1.r.c: O ni ila isọdi 1 nikan, kii ṣe 2 tabi ju bẹẹ lọ.
l-m-e5-b01-40.s.s1.explain: Onigun mẹta equilateral ni ila isọdi 3, ko si ni isọdi aarin. Awọn apẹrẹ miiran tako ọkan ninu awọn ipo.
l-m-e5-b01-40.s.s2.model.0: Onigun mẹta equilateral ni ila isọdi 3, o kere ju 2, ko si ni isọdi aarin; nitorina o ba awọn ipo mu.
l-m-e5-b01-40.s.s2.model.1: Onigun mẹrin deede ati rectangle ni isọdi aarin, onigun mẹta ẹgbẹ meji dọgba ni ila 1; equilateral nikan ni o ku.
